2. 贝里曲率与表面谱分析确认了陈数为±2的外尔节点及延展费米弧，表面态在无自旋轨道耦合时仍存在。
3. 费米能附近的表面态主要局域于最外层硅原子，为利用扫描隧道显微镜探测手性硅链相关的拓扑表面态提供了依据。

title: Spin-Orbit Coupling in Symmetry-Forbidden Reactions: A Selection Rule Tested on the Chalcogen Trimers
abstract: A reaction is forbidden by orbital symmetry when an occupied and an empty orbital of different symmetry change places along its path. With spin-orbit coupling orbitals become spinors, and those of two such orbitals can mix only if the orbitals differ by the symmetry of a rotation; the operator component of that symmetry couples ground state and diradical triplet. We test this rule on the ring opening of the chalcogen trimers O3 to Po3, where an in-plane and an out-of-plane orbital cross ($C_{2v}$ surfaces; NEVPT2, spin-orbit configuration interaction), by letting the operator components act separately. In Se3 and Te3 the component named by the rule alone lowers the barrier by 2.2 and 5.1 kcal/mol (complete operator: 2.2 and 5.2), the other two by 0.2 and 1.3 kcal/mol; in Po3 they contribute in second order. The triplet crosses the ground state 6.5 to 9.0 kcal/mol below the forbidden saddle. Spin-orbit coupling makes this crossing passable in O3 and S3 and, from Se3 on, merges the two states into one surface whose saddle lies 2.6, 5.5, and 13.1 kcal/mol lower. Molecular rotation obeys the same rule but is 6 to $2.8\times 10^{3}$ times weaker, which bears on the lifetime predicted for cyclic ozone.
summary:
1. 作者推导出轨道禁阻反应的选择定则：沿保持对称性的路径，自旋—轨道耦合允许基态连接双自由基三重态，当且仅当交叉轨道的对称性之积包含旋转表示。
2. 对O₃至Po₃开环的逐分量多参考计算表明，Se₃、Te₃中该定则指定的算符分量给出的势垒与全算符结果相差不超过0.2 kcal/mol。
3. 结果揭示，随自旋—轨道耦合增强，绕过轨道禁阻势垒的三重态通道从O₃、S₃的非绝热自旋转换转变为Se₃至Po₃的单势能面越垒过程。

title: A Thermodynamically Consistent Model of a Rechargeable Salt-in-Polyelectrolyte Battery
abstract: We present an isothermal, thermodynamically consistent model of a salt-in-polyelectrolyte battery with intercalation and deintercalation reactions of cations occurring at the electrode-electrolyte interfaces under galvanostatic conditions. For the electrolyte, we consider polyelectrolytes, which are polyanions, with neutralizing cations (i.e., counterions) such as lithium, along with a monovalent salt containing the same cations. Models of batteries containing either a dual-ion-conductor (DIC) electrolyte (i.e., uncharged polymers with added salt) or a single-ion-conductor (SIC) electrolyte (i.e., charged polymers without added salt) emerge as limiting cases of this thermodynamically consistent model. Once the model is presented in its most general context, we make specific choices so that it captures well-known mechanisms. In particular, the governing diffusion equations recover Fick's law of diffusion, and the cation-transfer reaction rate is described by the Butler--Volmer equation. The DIC and SIC limiting cases provide a framework for comparing the corresponding batteries. One-dimensional DIC and SIC charge--discharge simulations at matched current and duration illustrate concentration redistribution, polarization, and electrode utilization. Numerical accuracy checks quantify sensitivity to discretization; distinct initial inventories qualify the comparison.
summary:
1. 作者建立加盐聚电解质电池的等温恒流模型，耦合输运、泊松静电场与界面嵌脱反应，将单离子和双离子导体纳入统一框架。
2. 模型满足含端口电功率的自由能平衡，内部耗散非负且锂核数与电荷守恒，广义界面反应律经特定选择可还原巴特勒–沃尔默形式。
3. 采用线性反应律的一维单离子算例显示，强阳离子耗尽伴随电流反转后的界面反应滞后，表明端口电流与局域反应可异步反转。

title: Exact Lyapunov spectrum and localization length of the multichannel disordered Schrödinger equation
abstract: We consider the multichannel Schrödinger equation, describing the evolution of $N$ transverse modes in a finite width wire, in the presence of a Gaussian white noise potential in the unitary symmetry class. For arbitrary energy $E$ and disorder strength $T$, we compute exactly the set of Lyapunov exponents $\{ \gamma_n(E,T) \}_{1 \leq n \leq N}$ which define the decay rates of the wave functions. In the large energy regime, we recover that the Lyapunov exponents are equally spaced, as predicted by the so-called DMPK approach. However we show that this property breaks down at arbitrary energy, giving rise to a richer Lyapunov spectrum. We also uncover a direct relation between the localization length, given by the inverse of the smallest Lyapunov exponent, and the density of states. Our derivation relies on the analysis of matrix stochastic differential equation for a modified Riccati matrix.
summary:
1. 作者通过修正里卡蒂矩阵随机过程，精确求得幺正类各向同性高斯白噪声矩阵势导线在任意通道数N、能量和无序强度T下的李雅普诺夫全谱。
2. 该谱在一般能量下不等距，且局域化长度满足ℓ⁻¹=(T/2)∂_E lnν，其中ν为单位长度积分态密度。
3. 固定NT的大通道数极限下，这一关系给出谱边缘局域化长度的N^{1/5}标度及完整交叉函数。

title: Seebeck and Hall effects in charge-neutral ballistic graphene as probes of electron-electron interactions
abstract: Electron-hole asymmetry of the Coulomb velocity renormalization is responsible for finite Seebeck and Hall coefficients in charge-neutral graphene. In the ballistic regime the thermopower is small, $0.1$--$1~\mu$V/K, because the chemical-potential shift required by $n_e{=}n_h$ cancels its leading part. When the electron-electron scattering length falls below the sample length, the thermopower crosses over to a collision-dominated value of $4$--$10~\mu$V/K, that is an order of magnitude larger. This crossover is a direct thermoelectric marker of the breakdown of ballistic transport and a baseline for identifying the Dirac fluid.
summary:
1. 作者理论计算表明，电子—空穴不对称的库仑速度重整化使电中性石墨烯具有非零弹道塞贝克系数和半经典弱场霍尔系数。
2. 维持电子与空穴等密度的化学势偏移抵消热电势的主导贡献，使典型弹道值仅为0.1—1 μV/K；电子间散射长度短于样品后，碰撞主导值升至4—10 μV/K。
3. 跨越温度与库仑耦合强度平方及样品长度的乘积成反比，为标记弹道输运失效和识别狄拉克流体提供热电参照。

title: LetzElPhC: an electron-phonon code for efficient exciton-phonon workflows
abstract: We present \texttt{LetzElPhC}, an open-source software package that computes electron-phonon matrix elements from the output of density functional perturbation theory calculations performed with the \texttt{Quantum ESPRESSO} code. By interfacing directly with the \texttt{Yambo} code and exploiting crystal symmetries, \texttt{LetzElPhC} enables a scalable workflow for evaluating exciton-phonon matrix elements while enforcing strict gauge consistency between one-electron Bloch states and Bethe-Salpeter excitonic wave functions across the full Brillouin zone. This symmetry-preserving approach avoids phase ambiguities and significantly reduces both computational costs and memory requirements. To support large-scale simulations on dense momentum grids, the package incorporates Fourier interpolation of dynamical matrices and perturbed Kohn-Sham potentials, accounting for long-range dipole and quadrupole interactions in both two- and three-dimensional materials, combined with multi-level parallelization and efficient parallel I/O. Together, these capabilities seamlessly complement the \texttt{Yambo} code to enable first-principles simulations of phonon-assisted optical spectroscopies, which we demonstrate through applications to resonant Raman scattering in monolayer $\text{WSe}_2$ and phonon-assisted luminescence in cubic AgBr.
summary:
1. 作者开发LetzElPhC，通过共用布洛赫态和一致的对称展开，实现兼顾晶体对称性约化与全布里渊区规范一致性的激子—声子耦合计算。
2. 含长程偶极、四极项的插值在多类材料中与直接计算吻合，工作流再现单层WSe₂拉曼双峰结构及AgBr发光副峰的间距和相对强度。
3. AgBr最低L点激子向Γ点亮态的散射受宇称选择定则约束，仅允许LA、TO声子参与，揭示了低温发光双副峰的对称性起源。

title: Diffusion Effects on a Stochastic Amplifier Driven by the Square of a Gaussian Field: Discontinuous Transition to Intermittency
abstract: We study the effects of diffusion on the transition to intermittency in stochastic amplification driven by the square of a Gaussian field. The transition is characterized by an order parameter quantifying the spatial uniformity of the amplification. We consider a model in which the diffusion-amplification process is embedded in a random lattice of point absorbers in such a way that the Feynman-Kac formula is restricted to Brownian paths with a range not exceeding a finite cut-off. In this setting, with the Gaussian driving field in a wide class of physical interest, we show that diffusion-induced damping of the amplification is sufficiently strong to change the nature of the transition: from continuous in the absence of diffusion, to discontinuous in the presence of diffusion.
summary:
1. 针对高斯场平方驱动的有限时间随机放大，作者在吸收点间距有上界的一维模型中，通过布朗路径估计证明扩散使间歇性转变由连续变为不连续。
2. 对所研究的混合关联高斯场，临界耦合等于无扩散值，临界点的平均放大有限，表征空间均匀性的序参量在临界点为正、超临界区为零。
3. 这一结果意味着临界点属于非间歇区，且从亚临界侧逼近时不存在间歇性前兆。

title: High-Throughput Orientation Extraction via Symmetry-Adapted Filters
abstract: An algorithm for finding the orientation of objects in an image that have a known rotational symmetry, the symmetry-adapted filter (SAF) algorithm, is presented. It is deterministic and training-free, which makes it fast and reproducible. A filter that encodes the known rotational symmetry and approximate peak width is centered on the symmetry center of the object of interest, masked to the region of interest, and rotated to maximize its inner product with the image. The approach is demonstrated on more than 20,000 small-angle neutron scattering images of a torque-driven skyrmion lattice. It is also demonstrated on atomically resolved real-space images, where mapping local atomic orientations enabled the identification of grains and grain boundaries and the quantification of lattice relaxation.
summary:
1. 针对含噪及峰重叠图像中的取向提取，作者将已知旋转对称性编码为免训练滤波器，通过旋转并最大化其与图像的内积确定取向。
2. 该方法从两万余幅小角中子散射图中提取两组共存六重信号的取向，揭示斯格明子晶格随磁场降低由黏滑转为连续旋转。
3. 原子级取向映射进一步实现晶粒识别，并从模拟电镜图中定量提取晶界附近的取向弛豫长度，展示了同一方法对散射与实空间成像中晶格取向分析的适用性。

title: EGQCA Code: automated high-throughput thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions
abstract: Modeling disordered systems from first principles across the full composition range is a long-standing computational challenge. We present a code package implementing the extended generalized quasichemical approximation (EGQCA), which describes solid solutions through the statistics of a finite set of clusters and enables their thermodynamic modeling at arbitrary compositions and temperatures. The package automates the complete workflow and interfaces with both DFT codes and universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs). We show that replacing DFT with uMLIPs reduces the cost of the cluster calculations by up to five orders of magnitude while preserving the thermodynamic predictions. To make computationally demanding properties tractable, we additionally introduce a cluster-selection algorithm that identifies the most relevant configurations. Together, these developments establish EGQCA as a fast and accurate framework for the thermodynamic modeling of solid solutions and a practical route toward high-throughput screening of disordered materials.
summary:
1. 针对准二元固溶体的全成分热力学，作者实现EGQCA软件，以有限团簇统计统一处理混合焓、构型熵与振动自由能。
2. 忽略振动时，通用机器学习势使闪锌矿InGaN计算成本降低近五个数量级，互溶隙临界温度与DFT相差约6%；300 GPa、800 K下Nb–Ti仅用17个团簇即可再现331团簇系综的费米能级态密度成分依赖。
3. 预计算团簇数据可复用于不同成分和温度，结合代表构型筛选，为高通量评估固溶体相稳定性及昂贵物性提供了路径。

title: Frozen Phonons on Dense $\mathbf{q}$-Grids Using Set Covers
abstract: Phonon dynamics determine a vast number of properties in the solid state, such as the heat capacity, thermal expansion, and thermal conductivity. Phonons are obtained through the dynamical matrix, which, in the frozen phonon approach, is calculated as a finite difference derivative of the analytical Hellmann-Feynman force. This approach unfortunately typically suffers from requiring very large supercells, even for modest $\mathbf{q}$-grids. The non-diagonal supercell method remedies this issue by determining the smallest supercell commensurate with a given $\mathbf{q}$-point, drastically reducing the supercell size, but in turn requiring a new supercell for each $\mathbf{q}$-point on the grid. This introduces redundancy, however, since a single non-diagonal supercell may be commensurate with several $\mathbf{q}$-points. In this work I present a method to determine a minimal set of supercells, such that every $\mathbf{q}$-point on the grid is commensurate with at least one supercell. I present an algorithm to solve the problem and prove that it yields the optimal solution, before summarizing the algorithm using pseudocode. The scaling of the number of supercells with the density of the grid is discussed. Numerical results on a variety of systems show the significant computational advantage of the method, which increases with the density of the grid.
summary:
1. 针对稠密均匀q网格冻结声子计算的超胞冗余，作者利用整倍数波矢共享超胞的关系构造集合覆盖算法，并证明其给出最少非对角超胞集合。
2. 数值拟合显示超胞数随网格边长在二维近似线性、三维近似平方增长，铝与氟化钙在16³网格上的计算较逐点非对角超胞法快约五倍。
3. 该方法的约简收益独立于晶体对称性，可进一步结合对称性约简，并拓展至电子—声子耦合和高阶力常数计算。

title: Transverse Shifts Driven by Geometric Orbital Torque in Altermagnets
abstract: Anomalous transverse shifts in interface reflection are conventionally attributed to spin-orbit coupling or its pseudospin analogue. Here, we uncover a distinct geometric mechanism driven solely by an orbital torque arising from Fermi-surface anisotropy. During total reflection, an incident wave packet penetrates the anisotropic transmitted medium as an evanescent wave. There, the broken rotational symmetry about the interface normal exerts an orbital torque, and the accumulated angular impulse---the product of the torque and the dwell time---leads to a transverse spatial shift. Applying this mechanism to altermagnets without spin-orbit coupling, we show that the orbital torque is odd in spin. As a consequence, the two spin channels are deflected to opposite sides of the incident plane, giving an intrinsic spatial spin separation in altermagnets. The shift also inherits the angular symmetry of the altermagnetic spin splitting and is strongly enhanced near the onset of total reflection. Our work thus uncovers a new mechanism for transverse shifts, predicts a novel spin separation effect in altermagnets, and offers a direct probe of the altermagnetic order.
summary:
1. 作者在无自旋轨道耦合的正常金属—交替磁体结中解析揭示，费米面各向异性诱导的轨道力矩在倏逝波驻留期间积累角冲量，驱动全反射波包横向偏移。
2. 两自旋分量受反向力矩而向入射面两侧分离，位移在全反射阈值附近增强，所选参数下的d波模型给出约4纳米的最大位移。
3. 位移零点标定自旋劈裂极大方向，开放费米面的位移抑制区编码晶向与各向异性，为探测交替磁序及费米面几何提供途径。

title: Emergent Chern metal in strongly correlated moiré bilayers
abstract: We investigate the topological properties of a strongly correlated moiré transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) bilayer (such as twisted $\mathrm{MoTe}_2$ or $\mathrm{WSe}_2$) hosting a spin-charge separated state coupled to a layer-polarized helical spin texture. Analyzing an effective low-energy Hamiltonian for mobile spinless holons moving through this non-coplanar spinon background, we reveal pronounced asymmetric band warping. This warping closes the global indirect band gap across most of the parameter space, restricting true topological insulators to fine-tuned critical trajectories. However, a finite local direct gap persists, stabilizing broad regions of a topological Chern metal ($C = \pm 1$). Computing the Chern number and density of states, we demonstrate that this phase naturally yields a sizable, non-quantized anomalous Hall response accompanied by finite longitudinal conduction, providing a purely electronic strong-coupling mechanism for dissipative anomalous Hall states in moiré systems.
summary:
1. 针对强关联莫尔过渡金属硫族化合物双层中自旋纹理诱导的拓扑输运，作者在自旋电荷分离框架下推导了静态层极化反铁磁螺旋背景中的空穴子有效模型。
2. 计算发现，非对称能带翘曲在广泛参数区造成间接带重叠并保留有限直接能隙，形成能带陈数为±1、手性边缘态与导电体态共存的陈金属。
3. 这一结果为非量子化反常霍尔响应与纵向导电共存提供了单带强耦合机制，垂直位移场可通过能带反转调控其拓扑性质。

title: Monotonic probes of asymmetry and robustness of the quantum Mpemba effect
abstract: Entanglement asymmetry has emerged as a powerful probe of symmetry restoration and the quantum Mpemba effect. However, its conventional Rényi generalizations, defined as differences of Rényi entropies, are not monotones in the resource-theoretic sense. Here, we investigate an alternative family of asymmetry quantifiers based on sandwiched Rényi divergences, which satisfy monotonicity under symmetry-preserving quantum channels. Developing a two-parameter replica approach, we show how these quantities can be computed from charged moments and establish a remarkable correspondence with conventional Rényi asymmetries under the inversion of the Rényi index, $\alpha\leftrightarrow 1/\alpha$. This relation, exact for pure states, holds at leading order in the relevant scaling limits for homogeneous quantum quenches, including interacting integrable systems, and for Haar-random states. Applying these results to quenches from tilted ferromagnetic states, we demonstrate that the quantum Mpemba effect is remarkably robust, occurring throughout the entire family of sandwiched Rényi asymmetry monotones. We identify dynamical regimes in quenches from spatially inhomogeneous initial states where conventional Rényi asymmetries and genuine monotones exhibit qualitatively different behaviours. We also investigate a solvable toy model illustrating the possible dependence of Mpemba crossings on the Rényi index. Our findings establish a connection between conventional Rényi asymmetries and quantum resource theory, explaining their effectiveness in broad classes of nonequilibrium protocols while highlighting the additional information provided by genuine asymmetry monotones.
summary:
1. 为检验量子姆彭巴效应对度量的依赖，作者用双参数副本法从带电矩计算夹心Rényi散度型非对称性单调量。
2. 单调量与传统熵差的α↔1/α对应对纯态精确成立，在均匀可积淬火及Haar随机态的相应标度极限下主导阶成立；倾斜铁磁态自由淬火的姆彭巴反转遍及1/2≤α<∞。
3. 补集初态对称的非均匀淬火中，传统熵差暂态增长、资源单调量受初值上界约束，揭示了谱与电荷扇区重排和非对称性资源增长的区别。

title: Brightening spin- and parity-forbidden interlayer excitons through rhombohedral stacking
abstract: Brightened symmetry-forbidden excitons can provide critical information about the electronic structure and many-body interactions in semiconductors. Recently, interlayer atomic registry has emerged as a new way to control atomically thin layered materials in both ground and excited states. Here we show that the rhombohedral stacking in a 3R-MoS_2 homobilayer can brighten two symmetry-forbidden interlayer excitons: one is a spin-unlike 1s exciton and the other is a parity-odd 2p exciton. The nature of these interlayer excitons is revealed by their gfactors as well as the hybridization patterns observed when they are tuned to resonate with intralayer excitons. Surprisingly, the hybridized 2p exciton exhibits a constructive quantum interference between the acquired transition dipoles, revealing a hidden gauge-invariant phase contrast between the constituent electronic states. Our results establish stacking control as a powerful approach for modulating quantum phases of excitons in 2D semiconductors.
summary:
1. 作者结合电场调谐光谱与第一性原理计算，在菱方堆垛MoS₂同质双层中点亮并鉴定了自旋禁戒1s和宇称禁戒2p层间激子。
2. 2p态与上下层层内激子的耦合幅度分别为2.6和2.7 meV且符号相反，所获跃迁偶极的相长干涉使杂化态振子强度与层内激子相当。
3. 该干涉揭示了由导带与价带布洛赫旋量正交性保证的规范不变相位差，建立了借助堆垛调控的激子光学响应探测电子态相位信息的途径。

title: Magnons in solids with correlated atomic and nanoscale disorder
abstract: Atomic defects and disorder affect both the microscopic magnon excitations and the macroscopic physical properties of real-world magnetic materials. The rationalization of this relation has hitherto remained elusive, because of the intertwined challenges of simulating with quantum accuracy atomic- and nanoscale inhomogeneities and correlations, and their effect on the magnon spectral function determining observables such as spin stiffness. Here, we introduce a theoretical and computational framework to address these challenges. First, we develop the Coupled Optimization of SpIN Environment (COSINE) algorithm for efficiently relaxing the atomic structure and magnetic configuration of a solid with defects or disorder to a local energy minimum. Then, we discuss how to efficiently obtain exchange interactions accounting for local compositional, structural, and magnetic-moment inhomogeneities. Finally, we develop a paraunitary unfolding approach for Bogoliubov bosons, which allows us to predict the magnon spectral function in materials with any magnetic order, including systems with canting and full, partial, or no magnetic-moment compensation. We showcase our approach in a representative defective ferrimagnet for generality, and then combine it with state-of-the-art spin-informed machine-learning potentials to quantitatively predict how nonuniformities in the spatial distribution of vacancy defects control blurring of effective magnon bandstructures.
summary:
1. 作者结合结构—磁矩联合优化、自旋感知机器学习势与赝幺正展开，建立了描述原子至纳米尺度相关无序对磁振子谱影响的计算框架，涵盖任意磁矩取向。
2. 在空位浓度同为3.2%的铁模型中，1/r相关空位在两个所选波矢处的磁振子线宽约为无关联空位的三分之一至二分之一。
3. 空位团簇化最强的样品具有最低的拟合自旋刚度，表明缺陷空间相关性也是调控长波磁响应的自由度。

title: Quantum critical collapse to an extremal black hole
abstract: It has been emphasized recently that some extremal black holes are "critical" solutions, lying at the threshold between gravitational collapse and dispersion. We study the effect of quantum gravity on critical solutions for the collapse of a thin shell of charged dust. We consider the Hamiltonian that generates the shell equation of motion with respect to the exterior Killing time and coincides with the ADM energy on-shell. Near criticality, this Hamiltonian is shown to be canonically equivalent to that of a Liouville theory with negative potential. After quantization, this model predicts that a collapsing shell has a non-trivial probability of undergoing a quantum mechanical bounce when its energy above extremality is comparable to the "breakdown scale". The bounce probability approaches unity at extremality. Hence this model predicts that the critical surface in the classical theory is thickened quantum mechanically into a "critical layer". The probability density function for the black hole energy is suppressed below the breakdown scale in the same way as found recently by Turiaci and Wu.
summary:
1. 作者研究量子效应对黑洞形成阈值的影响，将静质量略低于电荷的球对称带电尘埃薄壳近临界动力学正则映射为负势Liouville理论并作开放系统量子化。
2. 模型给出能量$E\ge Q$的定能壳反弹概率$P=\exp[-\sqrt{(E-Q)/E_\star}]$，在极端点等于1，其中$Q$为电荷、$E_\star$为失效能标。
3. 量子反弹将经典临界面展宽为能量厚度约$E_\star$的临界层，黑洞能量分布的近极端抑制因子正比于$\sqrt{E-Q}$，与JT引力结果一致。

title: The black hole IR triangle for scalar QED
abstract: We construct the black hole infrared triangle of scalar QED on a stretched Schwarzschild horizon at tree level. In the covariant phase space of the near-horizon Maxwell field, the soft charge is a corner term. The memory is the zero mode of the gauge-invariant radiative field along the generators. It is conjugate to the boundary gauge mode that labels the degenerate horizon vacua, and Gauss' law fixes it by the flux of charge through the horizon. The Noether flux of the residual gauge transformation through the stretched horizon is not conserved by the scattering, because charged matter crosses the stretched horizon in both directions. The flux with its matter part removed is the soft charge, which generates the large gauge transformation. Its Ward identity is equivalent to a soft photon theorem in every radiative partial wave, which we derive from the near-horizon Feynman rules and, where these do not control the emission, from the field equations at leading order. The main difference from null infinity is that on a stretched horizon both radial branches of the field are independent boundary data. The hard charge is a radial flux. With both branches present it weights each leg by the direction of its radial motion, and the soft factor is a sign per leg. The endpoint data on the two branches give two boundary observables, the time-integrated transverse magnetic and electric fields. The field radiated by a scattering process contributes only to the first, where it cancels the change in the Coulomb memory of the charges, so that the soft charge is conserved. A charge that crosses the horizon enters both. We also discuss the infrared divergence, the dressing of the external states, and the fate of the memory in the Hartle--Hawking state, where it performs a random walk driven by the Hawking radiation.
summary:
1. 作者在施瓦西黑洞的拉伸视界上构建了树级标量量子电动力学红外三角，将大规范对称性、软光子定理与视界记忆联系起来。
2. 软荷的沃德恒等式等价于每个辐射分波的软光子定理，两条径向分支作为独立边界数据，使硬荷依径向运动方向加权，软因子逐腿取正负号。
3. 记忆与标记简并视界真空的边界规范模共轭，并由穿越视界的电荷通量固定，散射辐射的贡献抵消电荷的库仑记忆变化，从而保证软荷守恒。

title: The OPE of lines beyond CFT
abstract: We discuss the fusion of parallel line defects in theories defined by relevant deformations of a conformal fixed point. We propose an operator product expansion to describe this limit in terms of a Wilsonian effective action whose coefficients are computable in conformal perturbation theory around the UV. This allows one to fix, order by order, the fusion limit of correlation functions involving the defects, up to non-perturbative coefficients associated to correlation functions (condensates) on the fused defect. It thus generalizes the familiar OPE of local operators in QFT. As a non-perturbative test of our proposal, we consider the short-distance potential between two magnetic impurities in the $2d$ Ising model. We find excellent agreement between the OPE framework and DMRG extractions of the potential and condensates (the latter also computed exactly with integrability). In addition, we consider a number of solvable models to illustrate different features of the framework.
summary:
1. 针对共形固定点经相关形变所得理论中平行线缺陷的融合，作者提出威尔逊有效作用量形式的算符乘积展开，其系数可由紫外共形微扰论逐阶计算。
2. 在二维伊辛模型中，该框架给出的两磁性杂质短程势及凝聚量与DMRG提取结果高度吻合，凝聚量还由可积性精确计算。
3. 该框架将局域算符OPE推广至非共形理论的线缺陷，使关联函数的融合极限可逐阶确定，所需非微扰输入归结为融合缺陷上的凝聚量。

title: The String Theory Photinoverse
abstract: Type-IIB string compactifications typically give rise to a significant number of RR-photons. These are generically massless and do not possess any light charged states, making them `superhidden'. However, since supersymmetry is present at least at some high scale, corresponding `dark photinos' are also predicted. The kinetic mixing of the photons together with the SUSY breaking mass terms of the photinos makes the latter observable. We identify geometries in which the mixing is induced by Wilson lines and show that their expectation values are generically non-zero. As a result, most of the dark photinos, which are lighter than the visible sector SUSY breaking scale, mix significantly with the bino and hence couple to the Standard Model sufficiently strongly to leave potentially observable traces. In particular, volume modulus and inflaton decays generically induce a cosmological abundance of dark photinos that can explain dark matter. We find that the `natural Photinoverse dark matter parameter space' is already accessible to current experiments, notably gamma ray observations, which therefore have discovery potential in the near future.
summary:
1. 作者研究IIB弦紧致化中暗光微子的可观测性，构造含共享三维闭链的几何，揭示威尔逊线与超对称破缺使其混入bino的机制。
2. 在复结构F项由修正诱导的大体积情景下，威尔逊线一般稳定于非零值，多数暗光微子的质量与bino混合分别按体积平方倒数和体积倒数缩放。
3. 若R宇称守恒且由体积模衰变再加热，暗光微子可构成全部暗物质，数量级估算表明相应参数区已受到现有伽马射线观测约束。

title: Gauge groups of type 0 orientifolds
abstract: We determine the global form of the gauge groups of the orthogonal and symplectic type 0 orientifolds, using the constraints from perturbative and brane states. In the process, we correct some misprints in type 0 vacuum amplitudes that have propagated in the literature. For type 0A, our analysis reveals a parity condition on the numbers of D9-branes in the orthogonal orientifold and a puzzle concerning the decay of a tachyonic D0-brane in the symplectic orientifold.
summary:
1. 作者利用微扰态与膜态施加的约束，确定了0型弦论中正交与辛两类定向投影模型的规范群全局形式。
2. 分析导出了0A型正交定向投影中D9膜数目的奇偶条件，并修正了文献中沿用的0型真空振幅误植。
3. 膜态分析还揭示了0A型辛定向投影中快子D0膜衰变的未解疑难，提出了这一模型中具体的衰变问题。

title: Unitarization from Spin Geometry
abstract: We derive the dimensional reduction of 10D super Yang-Mills theory on a general closed 6D spin manifold using spectral decompositions for the higher-dimensional gauge field and gaugino, keeping the infinite towers of Kaluza-Klein (KK) modes in the lower-dimensional theory. We then calculate tree-level $2 \rightarrow 2$ scattering amplitudes with external massive spinors and vectors in this lower-dimensional theory. By studying the high-energy behavior of these amplitudes and imposing perturbative unitarity, we derive several sum rules that involve the eigenvalues of Laplace and Dirac operators on the internal 6-manifold, together with products of cubic coupling constants of the KK modes. These give concrete realizations of the known unitarity sum rules for spontaneously broken gauge theories. We illustrate explicitly how the simplest sum rule is satisfied for flat tori and round spheres.
summary:
1. 作者将十维超杨–米尔斯理论在任意闭六维自旋流形上约化至四维，保留完整KK塔并计算含费米子的树级二体散射，揭示其高能幺正化机制。
2. 推导并以本征模完备性证明四条联系拉普拉斯、狄拉克谱与三点耦合的求和规则，使固定角振幅的E²与E增长项抵消。
3. 这些规则进一步证明，若费米子经某一有质量矢量与较重态耦合，该矢量必连接质量递增的无限费米子链。

title: Neural Network Field Theory and the AdS/CFT Correspondence
abstract: We develop a neural realization of massive scalar field theory on Euclidean anti--de Sitter space and its holographic boundary observables within neural network field theory (NN--FT). We construct Fourier--Bessel cosine neurons whose covariance reproduces the regulated massive AdS propagator exactly at finite network width, with the Gaussian field theory recovered in the infinite-width limit. We introduce quartic interactions through two complementary approaches. The first implements a prescribed interaction by deforming the neural parameter measure, while the second generates a local quartic interaction from the statistics of auxiliary binary neurons. Applying the BDHM prescription directly to the neural ensemble, we recover the scalar bulk-to-boundary propagator, the conformal boundary two-point function, and the leading connected four-point contact Witten diagram. We further show that distinct neural architectures can reproduce the same leading boundary correlators while defining inequivalent bulk theories. These results establish a framework for studying interacting scalar holography within NN--FT and clarify the role of neural architecture in encoding bulk dynamics and boundary observables.
summary:
1. 作者以傅里叶–贝塞尔神经元构造固定欧氏AdS上的有质量标量场，通过测度变形或二元辅助神经元的受控群体极限实现局域正四次相互作用。
2. 自由体传播子在固定正则化、任意有限宽度下精确再现，规定极限后的同一系综给出分离点的共形边界两点函数及4Δ>d时耦合一阶的四点接触Witten图。
3. 不同架构以不同体协方差再现相同的上述边界关联，揭示这组边界数据对应体动力学的非唯一性。

title: Energy plateau cascades from complex-time local quenches in thermal two-dimensional CFTs
abstract: In this work, we study local operator quenches in thermal two-dimensional conformal field theories with complex-time evolution, which can be viewed as an effective description of conditional dynamics in a system interacting with an environment. In contrast to quenches of the vacuum, the thermal initial state allows several conformal families to participate in the evolution. We show that their competition can produce cascades of approximately homogeneous energy plateaux, with successive plateaux approaching the energies of different primary states. Using conformal Ward identities on the cylinder and torus, we determine the local energy density and illustrate this behavior in free-field theories, the Ising model and Wess--Zumino--Witten models. We develop a cold-limit spectral description in which the dominant primary channel determines the height of each plateau, while conformal dimensions and operator matrix elements govern the transitions between them. For a fixed compact unitary CFT, we show that only finitely many primary channels can contribute to the leading plateau sequence. Finally, we discuss the large-central-charge regime, relating light-operator plateaux to few-particle sectors in thermal AdS and examining the limitations of this picture for heavy quenches.
summary:
1. 作者利用共形沃德恒等式与谱分解，揭示热态二维共形场论在圆周上的复时间局域主场淬火中，由热权重与欧氏滤波竞争形成近似均匀能量平台级联的机制。
2. 在低温与长滤波联合极限，谱代价下包络确定平台序列，且固定紧致幺正理论中参与领先序列的主场对须满足Δ_a+Δ_d≤Δ_O，因此主导通道仅有有限个。
3. 平台高度与交叉的有限温度位移分别反映输出主场的共形权重和算符矩阵元，建立了局域能量动力学与共形谱及算符代数的联系。

title: Bounds on Love Numbers and Quasinormal Modes from the Surface Impedance
abstract: The surface impedance of a body is fixed by its interior alone and encodes its entire tidal response. We derive bounds on Love numbers and quasinormal modes from constraints on the impedance that follow from either of two properties of a stable body: it is lossless, meaning that it dissipates no energy, or it is passive, meaning that it never gives back more energy than it has received. For a lossless body, every dynamical Love number is bounded from above and below, exactly in general relativity, in any renormalization scheme and at any scale. Earlier bounds are exact for Newtonian stars but fail for compact stars, because they take the response to arbitrarily fast tides to be zero or non-negative, whereas in general relativity it is negative. The quasinormal modes of a lossless body are also excluded from a region of the complex frequency plane set by the mass and radius. Each known Love number enlarges the excluded region. Conversely, the quasinormal modes bound each Love number from below, given the lower ones. For a passive body of horizon scale, such as a black hole, the static Love number lies in a window that closes onto the vanishing black-hole value as the body's surface approaches the horizon.
summary:
1. 针对非旋转致密天体潮汐与振荡响应的允许范围，作者利用表面阻抗分离内部动力学与外部长程引力，推导稳定天体在无耗散或被动条件下的约束。
2. 无耗散天体各阶动力学Love数的双边界适用于任意重整化方案与尺度，仅由质量和半径确定的准正常模禁区随已知Love数增多而扩大。
3. 被动天体的静态Love数介于无限刚性表面与自由表面的值之间，并随表面趋近视界收敛至黑洞的零值，从被动性确立了静态潮汐响应的黑洞极限。

title: Chaotic singularities inside vacuum black holes
abstract: According to the conjecture of Belinski, Khalatnikov and Lifshitz, general relativity gives rise to chaotic dynamics in the vicinity of generic spacelike singularities. However, no vacuum black hole has been shown to exhibit this behaviour. Here we construct stationary, asymptotically locally AdS$_5$ black holes with regular, triaxially squashed horizons and causal exteriors, whose homogeneous interiors realize the cosmological billiard of generic five-dimensional vacuum gravity. We identify a simple algebraic condition on the horizon data that is necessary for the interior billiard to be chaotic, and show that solutions with regular horizons locally access an open set of billiard trajectories.
summary:
1. 针对真空黑洞能否容纳BKL混沌奇点，作者数值构造了视界正则且三轴压扁、外部满足因果性的平稳渐近局部AdS₅黑洞。
2. 其均匀内部实现五维真空引力的有限体积AE₄宇宙学台球，52次孤立反弹符合Kasner跃迁规则，并遍及全部四面主导势壁。
3. 固定视界面积下，视界参数到台球位置和方向的雅可比数值满秩，表明正则且外部因果的黑洞局部可达混沌轨道开集。

title: RMT${}_2$: Random Spectral Correlations for CFT${}_2$ and AdS${}_3$ Gravity
abstract: We present the full framework of RMT${}_2$, a consistent unification of random matrix theory and modular invariance. The systematic prescription, which augments the existing construction by incorporating spin, lifts random matrix correlators to $\text{SL}(2,\mathbb{Z})$ Poincaré sums of their Mellin transforms, in a manner which enforces random matrix correlations near extremality in every spinning primary sector. The resulting RMT${}_2$ correlators are further expressible in terms of an orthogonal basis of Eisenstein series and Maass cusp forms. We demonstrate the construction by lifting the two-point correlators at arbitrary genus of the Airy model, in both unitary and orthogonal symmetry classes, exhibiting the modular-invariant topological expansion of RMT${}_2$; a resummation of the genus expansion shows that the modular-invariant spectral form factor preserves the ramp-plateau structure. Holographically, RMT${}_2$ provides a concrete benchmark and explicit candidate expressions for comparison with off-shell wormhole amplitudes in AdS${}_3$ gravity, with any number of torus boundaries. We explicitly compute the universal RMT${}_2$ three-point correlator, corresponding to the putative three-boundary wormhole.
summary:
1. 作者利用梅林变换和庞加莱求和构建模不变多点谱关联，在二维共形场论每个固定自旋扇区的近极端初级态谱中恢复指定随机矩阵统计。
2. 作者求得幺正与正交类Airy模型的任意亏格两点关联，亏格重求和表明τ标度极限保留斜坡—平台过渡，模修正处于次领先阶。
3. 零亏格两点关联重现已知AdS₃双边界虫洞振幅，同阶三点关联为三环面边界虫洞提供候选振幅，构成引力计算的具体比较基准。

title: Machine Learning for Calabi--Yau Geometry and Heterotic Compactification
abstract: Quantitative predictions from string compactification depend on geometric data that are difficult to compute analytically. This review surveys machine learning approaches to predicting topological properties of Calabi-Yau manifolds, discusses the search for new Calabi-Yau fourfolds, as well as numerical methods for approximating Ricci-flat metrics. In the context of heterotic compactifications, we explain how bundle metrics and harmonic matter forms enter calculations of canonically normalized Yukawa couplings and axion-matter interactions. We also outline applications to flux compactifications, warped and corrected backgrounds, and geometric structures beyond the Calabi-Yau setting. Finally, we review available datasets and software, highlight connections with analytic methods, and discuss geometric constraints, numerical validation, and recent progress in rigorous error control.
summary:
1. 围绕弦紧致化所需几何数据的计算难题，本文综述卡拉比–丘流形拓扑的机器学习预测、新卡拉比–丘四重流形的搜寻及里奇平坦度规的数值逼近。
2. 在杂弦紧致化中，丛度规与调和物质形式为正则归一化汤川耦合及轴子–物质相互作用的计算提供几何输入。
3. 综述还讨论通量紧致化、翘曲与修正背景及非卡拉比–丘几何中的应用，并梳理几何约束、数值验证和严格误差控制的进展。

title: On the Structure Constants of ${\cal N}=2$ Liouville Theory
abstract: We show the structure constants of $\mathcal{N}=2$ spacelike Liouville theory. The absence of self-duality under $b\leftrightarrow b^{-1}$, where $b$ is the Liouville coupling, prevents a straightforward application of the standard bootstrap methods used in $\mathcal{N}=0$ and $\mathcal{N}=1$ Liouville theory. Motivated by the fermionic FZZ duality with the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})/U(1)$ supercoset theory, we establish an algebraic correspondence between the two theories, including a matching of their null vectors. We then derive the three-point structure constants in superspace. The neutral sector structure constants are associated with the spectral-flow-preserving structure constant of the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$ WZW model, while the two charged sectors correspond to its spectral-flow-violating structure constants. Finally, we give the correct relative normalization between the neutral and charged sectors and test crossing symmetry numerically.
summary:
1. 作者通过SL(2,R)/U(1)超陪集对应及一、二级零矢量匹配，求得类空N=2 Liouville理论NS扇区的超空间三点结构常数。
2. 中性与两带电扇区分别对应WZW模型的谱流守恒与不守恒结构常数，交叉对称数值检验在100组测试中的79组以10⁻³精度确认了扇区间相对归一化。
3. 这些超越半经典近似的动力学数据为二维费米黑洞和NS5膜近喉背景中的弦关联函数计算提供了输入。

title: Identifying Renormalization Group Interfaces of Massless WZW Flows $\widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_k \to \widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_1$
abstract: A renormalization-group interface encodes how a flow relates operators at short and long distances. We identify this interface up to topological dressing for the conjectured massless $\widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_k \to \widehat{\mathfrak{su}}(2)_1$ Wess-Zumino-Witten flows at every odd level $k\geq 3$. Global $SU(2)$ symmetry requires the interface to preserve a diagonal current algebra at level $k+1$, built from the currents on its two sides. The $\mathbb{Z}_2$ center symmetry then selects which representation labels the interface. This identification predicts distinct patterns of low-lying interface excitations for flows to the same infrared fixed point. Spin-chain calculations reproduce these patterns for $k=3$ and $5$, providing independent evidence for both conjectured flows.
summary:
1. 作者由自旋旋转与中心对称性，确定了所有奇数k≥3的猜想无质量WZW流SU(2)ₖ→SU(2)₁的基本重整化群界面族，唯一剩余自由度是拓扑修饰。
2. 对角表示标签固定为ρ=(k+1)/2，各磁化扇区最低共形权重与修饰无关，k=3、5时前三个正磁化扇区的权重比分别为1:3:7和1:3:6。
3. 自旋链数值谱支持这两组预测，为相应流提供独立证据，并表明界面激发可区分通向同一红外固定点的不同流。

title: An Argument for the Weak Gravity Conjecture from Constrained Wormholes
abstract: The gravitational path integral (GPI) computes inner products between states of open and closed universes in any low-energy effective theory. A well-defined Hilbert space requires these inner products to be positive semidefinite, but this positivity is not manifest in the effective theory. In this paper, we study the constraints that positivity imposes on Einstein--Maxwell theory coupled to charged matter in asymptotically flat space in $D\geq 4$ dimensions. We start by constructing a new class of constrained instantons that compute multi-boundary wormhole amplitudes. We show that, under mild assumptions, if no charged particle satisfies the weak gravity conjecture (WGC), these amplitudes violate positivity of the GPI. If instead some particle satisfies the WGC, the wormholes develop an instability that allows positivity to be restored. The same argument shows that positivity can only be restored if the magnetic WGC holds and the convex hull condition applies to theories with several $\mathrm{U}(1)$ gauge fields.
summary:
1. 作者构造受限瞬子计算多边界虫洞振幅，研究四维及以上渐近平坦时空中含带电物质的爱因斯坦–麦克斯韦理论所受的内积正半定性约束。
2. 在温和假设下，若无带电粒子满足弱引力猜想，引力路径积分便违反正半定性；若存在此类粒子，虫洞会出现允许恢复正半定性的不稳定性。
3. 这一希尔伯特空间一致性论证还表明，恢复正半定性要求磁弱引力猜想成立，并要求含多个U(1)规范场的理论满足凸包条件。

title: Probe branes from equivariant volumes
abstract: Classical Euclidean probe actions control non-perturbative weights and extended observables in holography. We present a geometric prescription for M2-branes in arbitrary BPS backgrounds and D3-branes in the five-form sector of type IIB. The framework accommodates compact and non-compact supersymmetric worldvolumes in both internal and spacetime directions, expressing their actions as relative equivariant pairings. Under stated extension and boundary assumptions, equivariant volumes evaluate these pairings without explicit background metrics and provide a regularization for non-compact probes. Examples in $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times SE_7$ backgrounds dual to ABJM, ADHM and flavored quiver theories reproduce and refine worldsheet-type instanton exponents and finite Wilson-loop actions. We also recover M2 giant-graviton and surface-defect actions in $\mathrm{AdS}_7\times S^4$. D3 probes in $SE_5$ compactifications dual to $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang--Mills and Klebanov--Witten theory provide tests involving giant gravitons, black hole probes and surface defects.
summary:
1. 作者在相容填充与边界匹配假设下，将超对称M2探针及IIB五形式通量介子扇区中一类D3探针的经典作用量表示为相对等变配对。
2. 等变体积无需显式度规即复现瞬子、巨引力子和黑洞探针作用量，并在威尔逊环及面缺陷实例中重现非紧致探针的有限作用量。
3. 体积齐次性进一步确定，固定电荷与内部Reeb方向时，AdS₄内部M2瞬子的领先作用量不随边界压扁变化，揭示了这类非微扰指数的几何不变性。

title: All known supersymmetric $\mathrm{AdS}_4 \times S^7$ uplifts from maximal supergravity
abstract: The solutions of $D=4$ $\mathcal N=8$ SO(8)-gauged supergravity uplift consistently to eleven dimensions. All known supersymmetric AdS$_4$ vacua of this theory lie in an $\mathcal N=1$ truncation containing seven chiral multiplets. In this paper, we work out the uplift of this seven-chiral sector, providing a unified eleven-dimensional geometric description of all known supersymmetric AdS$_4$ solutions in this class. We then specialise to the $\mathcal N=1$ vacua with U(1)$^2$ and SO(3) symmetry, obtain their new $D=11$ uplifts and bring out their internal geometries. Both of them admit a Kaluza--Klein-type description. For the U(1)$^2$ solution, this uses the global Hopf fibration of $S^7$ over $\mathbb{CP}^3$. One U(1) acts on the fibre, while the other generates the only continuous isometry of the deformed $\mathbb{CP}^3$ base. For the SO(3) solution, the geometry takes a local non-abelian Kaluza--Klein form, with SO(3) acting on the fibres and no residual continuous symmetry on the four-dimensional base.
summary:
1. 作者推导了四维最大SO(8)规范超引力七手征多重态扇区的十一维提升，统一给出该理论全部五个已知超对称AdS₄真空的翘曲因子、内部度规和三形式势。
2. 新构造的U(1)²和SO(3)对称𝒩=1解经数值检验满足十一维场方程，其内部几何分别具有以ℂP³为底的全局Hopf圆纤维化和局域非阿贝尔Kaluza–Klein结构。
3. 这些显式度规与通量为研究低对称超对称背景中的膜动力学及可能的膜瞬子提供了起点。

title: Holographic probes and Krylov complexity on asymptotically Lifshitz rotating black branes
abstract: We study two types of holographic probes on a five-dimensional, asymptotically Lifshitz, rotating black hole. This geometry solves the field equations of Einstein gravity coupled to a dilaton, two axionic scalars, and a Maxwell doublet, supplemented by two vector doublets that enter the action through a parity-odd, Chern-Simons-like combination, as recently found in \cite{Bravo-Gaete:2026bdq}. This spacetime provides a concrete bottom-up arena to explore the imprints of rotation on probes in non-relativistic holography. First, we compute the holographic static quark-antiquark potential following the standard prescription that relates this boundary observable to the on shell-action of a string configuration whose endpoints are anchored at the boundary. We find that the screening length decreases both when the angular momentum is increased at fixed temperature and when the temperature is increased at fixed angular momentum. The former reflects centrifugal effects on the $q\bar{q}$ pair, whereas the latter stems from enhanced thermal fluctuations, which weaken correlations at a given separation. Second, we compute the growth rate of the Krylov complexity, using the holographic prescription that relates this observable to the momentum of a massive particle probe falling into the IR. In particular, we find that, at a given instant, the complexity grows faster as the dynamical exponent $z$ is increased.
summary:
1. 作者在五维渐近Lifshitz旋转黑膜（2<z<3）上，采用弦探针与粒子动量的全息处方，计算沿旋转方向的重夸克势及Krylov复杂度。
2. 定温增大旋转参数或定旋转参数升温均缩短屏蔽长度，复杂度早期正比于t²，晚期数值拟合为C_K∝e^{2πTt}。
3. 晚期增长指数对旋转几乎不敏感，显示温度控制其增长尺度；固定温度与旋转参数时，增大z提高同一时刻的复杂度增长率。

title: The Dirac equation in arbitrary coordinate systems and curved spacetimes - An orthonormal frames approach
abstract: In this pedagogical article we discuss the Dirac equation in arbitrary coordinate systems. We explain the need for connections when dealing with spinor fields and present the practical steps needed to compute the Dirac operator in a general setting, allowing for arbitrary coordinate systems and position-dependent orthonormal gamma matrices, both of which can simplify computations in certain scenarios. The extension to include minimally coupled gravity is straightforward. Examples are provided, including constructing the Dirac equation in spherical and cylindrical symmetry (with or without gravity) and the Kerr spacetime. We also briefly comment on the advantages and disadvantages of various tetrads and orthonormal gamma matrices. This manuscript should be accessible to readers who have studied the Dirac equation at an introductory level (e.g., in Cartesian coordinates in flat spacetime with constant gamma matrices). The emphasis is on the use of orthonormal frames, since these correspond to the coordinate systems most familiar to readers when dealing with most field theories, and represent the physical frames where measurements are performed. The aim is to get the reader quickly to the point of being able to do calculations, so the presentation favors a concise, pragmatic approach over extended derivations.
summary:
1. 作者用正交归一标架整理任意坐标下狄拉克算符的构造，纳入满足厄米性条件的位置依赖γ矩阵，并给出球对称、柱对称及克尔时空的显式方程。
2. 在平直时空中采用球坐标标架和球投影γ矩阵时，矩阵导数项与里奇旋转项精确抵消，使旋量联络各分量均为零。
3. 该构造保持局域洛伦兹协变性和狄拉克流守恒，将曲线坐标中的旋量计算与无挠引力的最小耦合纳入同一框架。

title: Late-time OTOCs in Toda conformal field theory
abstract: We study late-time out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs) of semi-degenerate primary fields in two-dimensional $A_{N-1}$ Toda conformal field theory. In Liouville theory ($N=2$), we find that the OTOC decays as $t^{-3/2}$ when the continuum edge dominates, correcting a previously reported constant limit. For $N=3$, a transverse contour pinch reduces the spectral integral to one dimension. Assuming that the reduced expansion is complete, in the continuous phase the regulated edge behaves as a discrete state, and the OTOC approaches a pure braiding phase. As we check numerically, the edge block is a free-field correlator in a charge-neutral Weyl frame; this explains the pure phase and is consistent with crossing symmetry. For both $N=2$ and $N=3$, a dominant discrete residue gives a constant late-time limit. For $N\geq4$, the same one-dimensional reduction violates a crossing bound on the lowest intermediate weight of a positive diagonal expansion. Hence the $N=2,3$ phase diagram does not extend to higher rank without additional contributions below the reduced continuum edge or outside a positive diagonal expansion.
summary:
1. 作者通过谱分解与共形块单值变换，分析二维Toda理论半简并场归一化乱序关联函数的晚时行为及其主导中间态。
2. 连续相中，Liouville情形按$t^{-3/2}$衰减，修正既有常数结论；假设约化展开完备，$N=3$的正则化边缘共振给出纯编织相位，离散留数主导时两者均趋于常数。
3. Weyl对称外荷处的交叉对称性约束证明，$N\ge4$的完整关联函数须包含约化谱边缘以下的贡献或超出正对角展开，限定了低秩相图的适用范围。

title: Defect Correlators from Supergravity: Finding the Missing Contact Terms
abstract: We resolve a puzzle in the computation of holographic correlators using supergravity when defects are present. Previous direct supergravity calculations of defect two-point functions were found to differ from bootstrap results by a set of contact contributions. We show that the discrepancy arises from two effects: nonlinear Kaluza-Klein field redefinitions in the bulk, which induce additional quadratic couplings when applied consistently to localized sources, and off-shell terms in mixed bulk--defect vertices, which can collapse internal defect propagators. We demonstrate how these two mechanisms resolve the puzzle in two concrete examples in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, where we consider two-point correlators in the presence of a $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson line and on $\mathbb{RP}^4$.
summary:
1. 作者计算四维𝒩=4超杨–米尔斯理论在半BPS威尔逊线及RP⁴背景下的半BPS算符树级两点函数，补全超引力结果相较自举缺失的接触项。
2. 非线性卡鲁扎–克莱因场重定义诱导局域源的二次耦合，威尔逊线混合顶点的离壳项还使内部缺陷传播子塌缩，补全的接触贡献使计算与自举一致。
3. RP⁴上维数为二的算符两点函数的加性自举歧义由此固定为零，说明完整超引力耦合补足了超共形对称性未确定的接触信息。

title: Higher derivatives and ghosts through three centuries
abstract: We outline the history of the research of dynamic systems including higher derivatives in the Lagrangian, The story starts in 1744 when Euler published a book where the Euler--Lagrange differential equations for a HD system were first written. The next important landmarks were the papers of Ostrogradsky (1850) and of Pais and Uhlenbeck (1950). Many articles written in the second half of the last century were influenced by a misconception that was widespread at the time --- it was believed that higher derivatives necessarily bring about a violation of unitarity. We understand today that this is not the case and there are many systems with benign ghosts where HD are present but unitarity is not violated. In this review, we present and discuss several examples of such (quantum) mechanical systems and 2D field theories. Then we will briefly discuss higher-derivative gravity theories in 4 dimensions. In that case, the question whether the ghosts there are benign or not has a special status due to the absence of a nonperturbative Hamiltonian and does not have a definite answer yet. However, if one restricts oneself to classical theory, one can argue that the ghosts {\it are} benign (benign classical ghostly system is a system that needs an infinite time to reach a singularity, and it seems to the case both in ordinary and in HD gravity: the cosmic censorship conjecture implies that the singularities are always surrounded by horizons, and it takes an infinite time on the clocks of a distant observer to reach a horizon). Finally, I discuss supersymmetric HD theories: conformal supergravity, where the ghosts are also probably benign, and then an interesting supersymmetric HD gauge theory in 6 dimensions. It involves a dimensionless coupling constant, is renormalizable and rather beautiful. Unfortunately, it is not unitary --- ghosts are not benign there.
summary:
1. 作者以高阶导数是否必然破坏幺正性为主线，综述力学、二维场论及引力中的鬼动力学及其历史发展。
2. 一类精确可解的相互作用力学模型具有遍及实轴的能谱和幺正演化，二维经典场论实例展示无有限时爆破与李雅普诺夫不稳定性共存。
3. 四维高阶导数引力的量子幺正性尚无定论，以远处观测者计时的经典良性论证依赖宇宙监督假说。

title: Reconstructing massive quivers on a defect circle
abstract: We study the kink and particle spectra for the massive $\phi_{2,1}$-deformations of minimal models $\mathcal M_{k+1,k+2}$ via truncated conformal space approach (TCSA) on a defect circle. The massive $\phi_{2,1}$-deformation preserves a set of non-invertible symmetries, furnishing a fusion category $\mathcal C_k\simeq {\rm SO}(3)_k$. These non-invertible symmetries are spontaneously broken, and thus label the vacua and organize the kinks and particles into their multiplets in terms of quiver diagrams. We employ a finite-volume truncated Hamiltonian approach on defect Hilbert spaces, $\mathcal H_{X_i}$ for $X_i\in\mathcal C_k$, to study these quivers in the IR theories. The symmetry defect can then close an individual kink on a circle. We first establish the relation between states of definite fractional momentum on the defect circle and physical kink and particle states labelled by their vacuum pairs. Using form factors of local fields, we independently measure the squared amplitudes between the states of the two bases in defect TCSA. Combining these measurements with defect TCSA spectra, we reconstruct the quiver diagrams for $k=3,4,5$ without assuming them in advance. In particular, for $k=4$ we reconstruct the distinct quivers of the ordered and disordered phases. For $k=5$, we identify the quivers of both the light and heavy multiplets.
summary:
1. 作者利用缺陷圆上的截断共形空间计算与局域场形状因子，确定了φ₂,₁形变极小模型M_{k+1,k+2}在k=3、4、5时实现的扭结—粒子多重态。

3. 分数动量态与真空对态的对应，建立了从有限体积谱和局域测量提取红外箭图的途径，使自发破缺非可逆对称性组织的激发结构得到直接数值辨认。

title: Robin--Hadamard states for unstable field in half-Minkowski spacetime
abstract: We investigate the quantization of a real massless scalar field in four-dimensional half-Minkowski spacetime subject to an attractive Robin boundary condition. We show that the unstable modes, required for classical spectral completeness, are also essential to recover the canonical commutation relations (CCR) of the complete quantum field. By specifying the Cauchy covariances of the unstable sector, we construct a family of positive quasifree states compatible with the conservation of total energy. Within this family, positivity is incompatible with stationarity, so that the resulting states necessarily break the time-translation symmetry of the background. We also obtain a closed position-space representation of the two-point function for the chosen stable vacuum sector, including the contribution fixed by the CCR in the unstable sector. The resulting expression exhibits the direct and reflected singularities, including Robin-dependent logarithmic terms. Since the remaining unstable contribution is smooth, all states in the constructed family share the same singularity structure, consistent with the Robin--Hadamard framework.
summary:
1. 作者在吸引型Robin边界的四维半闵可夫斯基时空中，通过指定不稳定模的柯西协方差，构造了实无质量标量场的正准自由态族。
2. 证明不稳定模对恢复完整正则对易关系不可或缺，且该态族的正性排斥定常性，同时不稳定扇区能量守恒。
3. 不稳定贡献光滑，使各态共享直达奇性及含Robin对数项的反射奇性，表明边界诱导不稳定性与Robin–Hadamard型紫外结构相容。

title: Quark-Loop Corrections and Auxiliary Field-Strength Mixing in First-Order QCD
abstract: In the first-order formulation of Yang-Mills theory the gluon field strength is an independent auxiliary field $F$, and the only gluon self-interaction is a momentum-independent cubic vertex. We determine how quarks, which couple only to the gauge field, act on this structure. Their divergences are multiples of $f(A)\cdot f(A)$, a term absent from the first-order Lagrangian that no rescaling can produce. Working with the background-field method in a general covariant gauge, we find that the quark sector is renormalized entirely by the mixing of the auxiliary field with the field strength known from pure Yang-Mills theory, $F_0=F+z\,f(A)$, with quark coefficient $z=-\alpha_sT_FN_f/(6\pi\bar\epsilon)$, together with a rescaling of the gluon field and no rescaling of $F$, so that the renormalized auxiliary field runs into the gluon field strength. When a heavy quark of mass $M$ is integrated out, the same mixing survives as a finite threshold coefficient $c=(\alpha_sT_F/6\pi)\ln(M^2/\mu^2)$, whose scale dependence is exactly the heavy-quark share of the running, and the invariant combination of the couplings reproduces the decoupling of $\alpha_s$. Below the threshold, when the leading power correction is kept as a gauge-sector operator, the auxiliary field is no longer the field strength: $F=f(A)+(g\alpha_sT_F/15\pi M^2)(D_\alpha J_\beta-D_\beta J_\alpha)$, with $J$ the light-quark colour current. We verify this identity against the full theory and show that it separates the long-distance gluon exchange, carried by $F$, from the short-distance heavy-quark effect, carried by a four-quark contact term.
summary:
1. 作者用背景场法研究夸克圈对QCD一阶结构的影响，确定辅助场的一圈重整化及重夸克阈值匹配。
2. 夸克圈发散由辅助场与胶子场强混合及胶子重标度吸收，辅助场无需重标度，有限阈值混合的尺度依赖恰等于其演化中的重味贡献。

title: Black hole entropy from angular holonomies of Sine-Gordon soliton lattices in AdS$_3$
abstract: We construct boundary conditions for AdS$_3$ gravity that realize Sine-Gordon dynamics. For a periodic soliton lattice at fixed winding, we relate the angular holonomy to the exact acoustic dispersion by continuing the Bloch momentum through the zero-frequency band edge associated with rigid translation of the lattice. For suitable embedding angles, the stable vacuum has a regular BTZ geometry. When only one chiral sector carries winding, we construct a family whose asymptotic region extends to a BTZ black hole. As the spectral parameter of the winding sector tends to the corresponding band edge, the black hole approaches extremality. The leading correction to the extremal entropy is linear in the Hawking temperature defined with respect to laboratory time, with a coefficient inversely proportional to the sound velocity of the lattice. The same inverse-velocity dependence appears in the low-temperature entropy of one-dimensional quantum fluids.
summary:
1. 作者构造实现正弦–戈登动力学的AdS₃边界条件，通过平移零模带边处的布洛赫动量延拓，精确关联固定绕数孤子晶格的声学色散与角向和乐熵。
2. 对于仅一个手征扇区携带绕数且两扇区共用热周期的构型，作者构造正则BTZ外部延拓，得到固定绕数下近极端视界熵相对实验室温度的线性系数与晶格声速成反比。
3. 改用标准BTZ时间定义温度后，该线性系数与声速无关，表明逆声速响应体现了两种视界生成元的相对归一化。

title: Superconformal Index Identities for Dual Gauge Theories
abstract: We study superconformal index identities for three classes of dual four-dimensional gauge theories. For $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang--Mills theory with gauge groups $SO(2n+1)$ and $USp(2n)$, we prove at every rank the equality of flavored Schur indices predicted by $S$-duality, using Rains's diagonal trace transformation. For Kutasov--Schwimmer duality with adjoint superpotential $\textrm{Tr} X^{k+1}$, we prove the index identity between $SU(k+1)$ and $SU(k-1)$ with two flavors at independent elliptic nomes $p,q$, in the ultraviolet assignment $R(Q)=0$. On the locus $p=q^k$, we reduce the identity to that of ordinary supersymmetric QCD whenever the specialized expressions are generically regular. Finally, we test the dualities conjectured by Cho and Song between quiver and single-group descriptions of four families of Argyres--Douglas theories. For the rank-one $H_1$ theory we prove equality of the two full flavored indices, and for each family at arbitrary rank we evaluate the generalized Coulomb index in both descriptions, obtaining the product formula conjectured by Buican and Jiang.
summary:
1. 作者利用椭圆超几何积分变换，证明四维N=4杨–米尔斯理论中SO(2n+1)与USp(2n)的含味Schur指标在任意秩相等。
2. 在两味且R(Q)=0的紫外分级下，SU(k+1)与SU(k−1)的Kutasov–Schwimmer指标恒等式对独立p,q成立，秩一H₁两种描述的完整含味指标也被证明相等。
3. 四族Argyres–Douglas理论的箭图与单规范群描述在任意秩给出同一广义库仑指标，其乘积由库仑生成元标度维数决定，确证了Buican–Jiang猜想在这些理论中的成立。

title: Power-law tunneling in the Razavy hyperbolic double well: Heun connection formulas and their resonances
abstract: We study nonperturbative level splitting in the symmetric Razavy hyperbolic double well, relating its double-confluent Heun connection problem to exact WKB and quasi-exact solvability. In the weak-coupling limit the wells separate logarithmically and approach two Morse systems. Reflection factorizes the two-ended spectral condition into separate even and odd quantization conditions. For each normalizable Morse level with noninteger decay exponent, the irregular-block connection formula yields the leading splitting with its full gamma-function coefficient, two analytic fluctuation corrections, and the leading logarithmic three-traversal contribution. The noninteger power of the coupling follows from the logarithmic growth of the barrier action. We express the classical periods in terms of complete elliptic integrals and derive the first quantum-period correction. At integer exponent, a convergent reduction onto the two resonant Floquet modes resolves the singular fixed-order expansion into two local spectral branches and reproduces the known finite-spin tunneling gap.
summary:
1. 作者以双合流Heun连接公式和反射对称性，导出Razavy对称双阱在弱耦合极限下的奇偶量子化条件。
2. 对固定非整数r=β/ℏ−1−2n>0，求得ΔE∝κ^r的完整伽马函数系数、两阶解析涨落修正及首个含对数的三次穿越项。
3. 势垒作用量的对数增长解释了幂律隧穿的起源，整数共振的收敛双模约化给出平方根谱分支并重现有限自旋隧穿能隙，联系了连续双阱与准精确可解谱。

title: The all-loop spectrum of GGK strings
abstract: We study the non-perturbative spectrum of the non-relativistic limit of string theory in AdS$_5\times$S$^5$, also known as GGK theory. In light-cone gauge, we show that the bosonic spectrum on a number of vacua is described at all-loops by free massive and massless scalar fields in AdS$_2$, confirming a conjecture by de Leeuw, Fontanella and Nieto-García, arXiv:2403.09563 . In static gauge, we obtain the same result for any classical string vacuum, and including fermions. We compute the quantum correction to the classical energy, and show that it vanishes once we adopt the regularised Hurwitz series. We conclude that the quantum energy spectrum built upon any GGK string consists solely of its classical vacuum energy.
summary:
1. 针对AdS₅×S⁵非相对论极限中的GGK弦谱，作者在静态规范下证明任意经典闭弦真空周围的全圈涨落理论精确等价于AdS₂自由场。
2. 涨落包含三个有质量、五个无质量标量和八个有质量马约拉纳费米子，采用Hurwitz级数正规化后，玻色与费米零点能精确抵消，真空能无量子修正。
3. 该结果为GGK与伽利略杨–米尔斯理论的全息谱匹配提供了弦侧输入，并提示对偶算符的标度维数也可能不受量子修正。

title: Interfaces in Long Range CFT$_1$
abstract: We consider interfaces in the theory of a single free scalar in AdS$_2$ defined by adding relevant operators along portions of the boundary. We begin with Neumann/Dirichlet interfaces, computing the associated scaling dimension and $g$-factor ratio; we also explain how arbitrary interface correlators can be computed numerically efficiently. Then we move on to interfaces between generalized free field and long-range interacting theories such as long range Ising, determining many quantities in perturbation theory. Finally we setup a bootstrap problem for four-point interface correlator. We use this to find tight bounds on the $g$-factor ratio as a function of the interface scaling dimension.
summary:
