2. 他们求得诺伊曼／狄利克雷界面的标度维数与g因子比，并以微扰论计算广义自由场与长程伊辛等相互作用理论之间界面的多种物理量。
3. 界面四点函数的自举进一步给出g因子比随界面标度维数变化的紧界，定量限定了这两类界面数据的允许范围。

title: Entanglement and HBAR entropy in a Lorentzian non-commutative black hole
abstract: We investigate how Lorentzian non-commutative smearing affects entanglement and horizon brightened acceleration radiation (HBAR) outside a black hole. For a massless scalar field, tracing over the interior partner gives the exterior quantum channel, its logarithmic negativity, mutual information, and Bell entanglement fidelity. At fixed mass and Killing frequency, increasing the smearing lowers the surface gravity, increases the accessible correlations, and suppresses the leading atomic emission probability. The horizon displacement begins at order $\sqrt{\Theta}$, while the thermal correction at infinity begins at order $\Theta$. At fixed local frequency, the redshift introduces a term of order $\sqrt{\Theta}$ at fixed areal radius. Holding the proper distance fixed, it cancels this term and recovers the common Rindler response close to the horizon. For a freely falling atom, emission and absorption obey detailed balance at the Hawking temperature in the leading horizon approximation. Random atomic injection drives the selected mode from the vacuum to a thermal state with an exact relaxation law and nonnegative entropy production. Near equilibrium, we obtain $\dot S_{\rm HBAR}\simeq\dot A_p/4$ when the radiated energy is drawn from horizon heat, where $\dot A_p$ is the positive radiative area loss. When the radiation is assigned to ADM mass loss at fixed smearing length $\ell=4\sqrt{\Theta/\pi}$, the result is $\dot S_{\rm HBAR}\simeq\dot A_p/[4(1-\ell/r_+)]$. The mass dependence of the exterior source thus enters the entropy per unit area lost at order $\sqrt{\Theta}$.
summary:
1. 作者在洛伦兹型非对易涂抹的有效黑洞几何中，构建外部标量场纠缠信道，并求得自由落体原子束驱动的辐射热化与熵产生规律。
2. 固定质量、Killing频率及原子能隙时，涂抹增强纠缠并抑制近视界主阶发射，修正始于Θ阶；固定局域频率与固有距离消除了信道的√Θ阶修正。
3. 近热平衡的辐射熵—面积损失系数取决于能量归属：视界热量给出1/4，固定涂抹长度ℓ下的ADM质量损失给出1/[4(1−ℓ/r₊)]，揭示外部物质源的√Θ阶贡献。

title: Rényi multi-entropy from Riemann surfaces
abstract: We compute vacuum tripartite Rényi multi-entropy in a two-dimensional compact-boson conformal field theory (CFT). For every integer Rényi index $n\geq2$, we evaluate the partition function on the replica Riemann surface for disjoint intervals, obtaining the twist four-point function in terms of a ratio of theta functions. An independent calculation of the partition function on a Fermat curve yields the adjacent three-point coefficient. In the fusion limit, the Riemann surface for disjoint intervals degenerates into two Fermat curves, and the residue of the four-point function reproduces the squared three-point coefficient, as required by the operator product expansion. The genuine multi-entropy therefore approaches twice its strictly adjacent value. The CFT predictions agree with lattice calculations for the critical XXZ and Ising spin chains and a harmonic chain. We also exhibit a unitary CFT in which the canonical replica construction yields complex Rényi multi-entropy.
summary:
1. 作者用复制黎曼面配分函数，求得二维紧致玻色子共形场论中任意整数n≥2的真空三方Rényi多重熵，并将扭曲四点函数写成θ函数之比。
2. 融合极限下曲面退化为两条费马曲线，四点函数留数再现三点系数的平方，使真正多重熵趋于严格相邻值的两倍。
3. 预测与XXZ、伊辛及谐振子链的格点计算一致，幺正共形场论实例还表明标准复制构造可产生复数Rényi多重熵。

title: Logarithmic scalar soft factorization from matching conditions
abstract: Logarithmic soft theorems in QED and gravity can be understood as conservation laws associated with asymptotic symmetries. In contrast, for a massless scalar, no gauge symmetry is available to organize this relation. Despite that, we show that the logarithmic soft factorization for a massless scalar coupled to massive fermions through a Yukawa interaction follows from the asymptotic field equations and matching conditions at spatial infinity. From the first subleading logarithmic fall-off, we construct a conserved surface integral whose boundary values satisfy the antipodal map between past and future null infinity. At future null infinity, the field equations relate this quantity to the $1/u$ tail of the scalar radiation, while at past null infinity, for scattering states without incoming scalar radiation, it is carried by a non-radiative logarithm of the incoming particles. We derive the classical tail from the particle trajectories and obtain the hard charge from the asymptotic Dirac current. The particular solution of the leading scalar field gives the classical contribution, while its homogeneous component gives the quantum contribution. The resulting Ward identity reproduces the logarithmic soft coefficient of the one-loop scalar emission (up to a zero mode on the sphere), including its classical and quantum parts.
summary:
1. 在四维无质量标量与有质量狄拉克费米子耦合的汤川理论中，作者由渐近场方程和空间无穷远匹配构造了控制对数软辐射的对跖匹配守恒荷。
2. 所得沃德恒等式重现一圈发射振幅对数软系数的非恒定球谐分量，经典与量子贡献分别来自标量场的特解和齐次解。
3. 无入射标量辐射时，该荷将未来零无穷远的1/u辐射尾与过去零无穷远的非辐射径向对数相连，确立了无规范对称性理论中软辐射与渐近守恒律的联系。

title: A Pole-Cut Formula for Holographic Extremal Correlators
abstract: We show that the holographic spectral function of a neutral massless scalar on the extremal Reissner-Nordstrom black brane in $AdS_5$ admits an elegant formula in terms of the quasi-normal modes (QNMs) and branch-cut data. In the extremal case, the spectral data comprises the zeros of the boundary source function, i.e. the QNMs, as well as its phase discontinuity across the branch cut on the negative imaginary axis of the complex frequency plane. This formula neatly factorizes into an infinite product over the QNM poles and a factor encoding the branch cut discontinuity. We derive this pole-cut formula as the zero-temperature limit of the QNM product formula for holographic thermal correlators, with the branch-cut contribution arising from the coalescence of the QNMs on the negative imaginary axis. We also clarify the role of the near-horizon $AdS_2$ region in this context. Consistency with the OPE of the boundary correlator provides extremal sum-rules involving both the QNMs as well as the phase discontinuity function. We also find that this holographic consistency forces the asymptotic form of the QNMs to be related to the asymptotics of the phase discontinuity function. We verify our formula and these OPE constraints numerically. We also demonstrate that, in the time domain, the pole and cut factors each produce complex-time singularities, whose location is determined by the optical distance between the boundary and the black-brane singularity. We expect the pole-cut factorization structure of spectral functions to hold for more general fluctuations of extremal black branes.
summary:
1. 作者从有限温乘积公式的零温极限，建立了AdS₅极端Reissner–Nordström黑膜上中性无质量标量全息谱函数的重构公式。
2. 谱函数分解为准正规模极点乘积与源函数相位跃变决定的支割因子，虚轴极点与松原零点的凝聚共同生成支割，数值计算验证了该分解。
3. 算符乘积展开给出联结两类谱数据的求和规则及渐近约束，极点和支割贡献的复时间奇点位置由边界至黑膜奇点的光学距离确定。

title: Character expansion of the Itzykson-Zuber pair correlator
abstract: We revisit a long-standing problem of correlation functions with the Harish-Chandra-Itzykson-Zuber measure. The immediate goal is to reproduce the long-known answer for pair correlator in the form of character expansion - a sum over Schur polynomials with carefully adjusted coefficients. The infinite sum can be folded up into exponentials with the help of the Cauchy identity. What matters are the coefficients, which we express in terms of projectors, made from Cherednik operators. Development of character expansion methods for unitary integrals, which are much more difficult than the Hermitian ones, gives a hope for further generalizations - up to arbitrary correlators with non-trivial measures.
summary:
1. 针对HCIZ酉矩阵积分中矩阵元二点关联的特征标展开，作者提出了任意矩阵阶数下的Schur导数公式。
2. 由Cherednik算符构造的投影配对同一杨图去角分量，所得级数在N=2时重求和恢复已知指数解，在N=3时与已知结果吻合至总次数六。
3. 这一表示将本征值置换下非对称的关联函数纳入特征标方法，为推广至更高阶IZ关联函数提供了代数线索。

title: Time-weighted energy correlators are infrared unsafe in gauge theories
abstract: Energy correlators are infrared safe because each detector weights a parton by its energy, but a weight in the arrival time makes them infrared unsafe in gauge theories. For the state created by a scalar operator that makes two partons at lowest order in a weakly coupled conformal gauge theory, we show that the correlator of two time-weighted energy detectors (the light-ray operators $\int\!du\,u\,T_{uu}$) at separated directions diverges at two loops like the logarithm of the time window. The logarithm does not come from a single soft gluon, but from a soft parton pair with comparable energies, one parton in each detector; its coefficient is a closed-form function of the angle for any matter content. In $N=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, we recover this coefficient from the two-gluon Regge term of the known four-point function and derive a simple relation to the logarithm in the charge correlator. In the planar theory the leading logarithms resum to a power of the window, set by the BFKL intercept.
summary:
1. 在弱耦合共形规范理论中，作者针对标量源最低阶产生两个部分子的态，证明不同方向能流一阶时间矩的双点关联在两圈随时间窗对数发散。
2. 发散来自能量相近、分别进入两探测器的软部分子对，其负系数对任意物质组分均有闭式角分布，并与N=4超对称杨–米尔斯理论的双胶子Regge项吻合。
3. 这使源态在微扰论中位于非均匀角涂抹探测器的定义域之外，平面N=4理论中的领头对数重求和进一步给出BFKL截距控制的时间窗幂律增长。

title: Massive Triangle in Cosmological Correlator beyond Conformal Coupling
abstract: A massive scalar coupled in pairs to the inflaton generates a one-loop primordial bispectrum whose mass corrections at generic momenta have lacked closed analytic expressions beyond conformal coupling. We obtain two leading mass corrections at arbitrary external momenta in terms of multiple polylogarithms of uniform weights three and four. Auxiliary-energy dressings preserve rational time integrals, revealing unexpected simplicity despite elliptic intermediate geometry. Independent full-loop evaluations, including blinded predictions, validate the closed forms. We also determine a subleading light-field singularity and recover the heavy-mass effective theory.
summary:
1. 针对成对耦合暴胀子的有质量标量所诱导的单圈双谱，作者利用辅助能量修饰，求得共形耦合点附近前两阶质量修正的任意外动量闭式。
2. 两阶修正分别具有统一权重三和四，沿用共形点的六字母多对数字母表，二阶公式在六个盲测构型上与完整圈积分符合至约10⁻²⁰。
3. 结果表明，具有椭圆中间几何的该有质量圈图至二阶保持规范多对数结构，为在更高阶质量修正及其他圈拓扑中检验这一结构提供了解析基准。

title: Vacuum correlation measures as CFT partition functions
abstract: We show that in any $d$-dimensional CFT, the vacuum sandwiched Rényi mutual information (SRMI) of integer order $n$ between two disjoint balls maps to a CFT partition function on a manifold of topology $\#^{n-1}(S^1 \times S^{d-1})$, with moduli fixed by the ball configuration and single-ball modular flow. At $n=2$, it is given by the thermal partition function on $S^{d-1}$, upper-bounding the von Neumann mutual information. For $n>2$, SRMI diverges at finite separation due to a hot-spot limit of the partition function. Explicit CFT evaluations agree well with density matrix computations.
summary:
1. 作者利用径向缝合与单球模流，将任意维共形场论中两分离球的整数阶夹心Rényi互信息映射到缝合流形上的真空归一化配分函数。
2. 二阶等于球面热配分函数的对数并收紧互信息上界，三阶及以上在有限间距发散，显式计算与密度矩阵结果吻合。
3. 这些结果证明最大互信息在任意分离尺度均发散，并在经典引力近似下确定全息互信息相变交比以霍金–佩奇转变交比为下界。

title: An algebraic quantization of gravity from the null cone
abstract: We propose a background independent quantization of vacuum general relativity on four dimensional Lorentzian spacetimes. Starting from first order gravity, we solve the gravitational constraints on intersecting null cones of a bulk subregion and obtain the reduced phase space at finite $G_N$. We promote its canonical Poisson brackets to commutation relations and use deformations of the reduced action to define an algebra of observables. Equipped with this, we use Gaussian wavefunctions of canonical pairs to construct a nonperturbative Hilbert space representation, for which this algebra generates a type I factor. By composing amplitudes between states prepared on null cones, we then obtain a Lorentzian path integral in which each sum over intermediate states converges absolutely. As a check, we compute the amplitude for graviton pair creation and annihilation on a null cone nonperturbatively in $G_N$ and find a finite closed form expression, even though expanding first in $G_N$ yields a logarithmic divergence. We next use diffeomorphism invariance of the path integral to show that a macroscopic causal diamond with a given maximum size has a finite dimensional Hilbert space. From the Lorentzian trace we obtain the Bekenstein Hawking entropy for marginally trapped surfaces and calculate its logarithmic correction for large Schwarzschild black holes, recovering at one loop the coefficient Sen obtained through Euclidean methods. We end by deriving the semiclassical Einstein equations to one loop as the low energy limit of this theory.
summary:
1. 作者求解相交零锥上的引力约束，建立四维洛伦兹真空广义相对论在有限牛顿常数下的背景无关非微扰代数量子化。
2. 引力子对产生与湮灭振幅得到非微扰有限闭式解，先按牛顿常数展开的计算出现对数发散；微分同胚不变性还推出给定最大尺度的宏观因果菱形具有有限维希尔伯特空间。
3. 该理论给出边际俘获面的贝肯斯坦–霍金熵，复现大史瓦西黑洞熵的一圈对数修正系数，并在低能极限导出一圈半经典爱因斯坦方程。

title: A Coupled Thermomechanical Model with Volterra Memory: Influence of the Kernel Class on Relaxation Asymptotics
abstract: The aim of this study is to determine how the class and asymptotic behaviour of a Volterra memory kernel influence relaxation in a coupled thermomechanical model. The model describes the mutual interaction between an internal mechanical variable and temperature through temperature-dependent material properties and mechanical dissipation. The analysis combines a Volterra integral formulation, a spectral representation of the memory mechanism, thermodynamic decomposition of the hereditary power, local well-posedness analysis, linearization near equilibrium, and Laplace-transform asymptotic arguments. The spectral representation separates the energy stored in the relaxation modes from irreversible hereditary dissipation and establishes the thermodynamic consistency of the memory contribution. Under minimal assumptions on the constitutive functions and the kernel, local existence and uniqueness of solutions are obtained; for thermodynamically dissipative memory and a non-negative external heat source, positivity of the absolute temperature is preserved. The main result concerns the linearized dynamics near equilibrium: with the thermomechanical coupling kept unchanged, an exponential kernel produces exponential relaxation, whereas a power-law kernel with a long tail produces algebraic relaxation. A numerical comparison performed for the same set of dimensionless thermomechanical parameters illustrates these two asymptotic regimes. The results show that changing the class of the memory kernel alone can change the qualitative long-time relaxation law of the coupled system.
summary:
1. 作者针对记忆核如何控制热力耦合弛豫，建立均匀热黏弹性Volterra模型，并以非负弛豫谱分离记忆储能与不可逆耗散。
2. 在稳定性与解析延拓条件下，近平衡线性化系统的指数核产生指数弛豫，幂律核使非零初始机械扰动按t⁻ᵖ（0<p<1）衰减，p=0.5时数值指数为0.494。
3. 这表明，固定热力耦合及瞬时材料参数时，记忆谱本身足以改变长期弛豫类别，宽弛豫时间谱保留了久远历史的影响。

title: Time-reflection nonlocal equations from $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$-symmetric oscillator pairs: physical origin and variational formulation
abstract: We show that every second-order differential equation with time reflection describes the $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$-symmetric solutions of a local pair of oscillators that is invariant under exchange combined with time reversal. For linear equations the pair is built from springs, balanced gain and loss, and a gyroscopic coupling. We determine when such a pair has a regular first-order Lagrangian, and when the solutions of the equation fix its coefficients. As the main example, we consider a recently studied equation whose solutions do not depend on its velocity coupling. In the corresponding pair this coupling acts only on the conserved total momentum, which vanishes for $\mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}$-symmetric solutions, and each of the two conditions that single out the model places the pair at an exceptional point. When the spring and velocity couplings are both nonzero, the pair has no regular first-order Lagrangian, while the equation has one with second derivatives. We also propose an electronic realization and construct a Bateman-type Hamiltonian, from which the velocity coupling is removed by a canonical transformation.
summary:
1. 作者证明，任意含时间反射的二阶方程均对应局域振子对的PT对称轨迹，并确定线性振子对存在正则一阶拉格朗日量的条件。
2. 示例模型的速度相关力正比于守恒总动量，PT对称轨迹上该动量为零，从而解释了解严格独立于速度耦合强度的物理机制。
3. 当该模型的弹簧与速度耦合均非零时，振子对不存在正则一阶拉格朗日量，作者构造的退化二阶导数作用量无需额外初始数据即可恢复其完整动力学。

title: A computer-assisted proof of one-cell snaking and lattice trapping for a nonlinear square lattice
abstract: We establish a computer-assisted proof of lattice trapping in an infinite nonlinear square lattice with interaction potential $\phi(t)=(1-e^{-3t^2})/6$ and an antiplane crack far field $K\sqrt{r}\sin(\theta/2)$. We construct a connected branch of equilibria whose single-cell segment contains exactly two nondegenerate quadratic folds, with a stability sequence of stable, Morse index one, and stable in the full energy space. The fold loads satisfy $0.45897<K_-<0.45923$ and $0.46219<K_+<0.46242$, establishing a strictly positive lattice-trapping width $K_+-K_->0.00296$. A uniqueness argument establishes exact translation closure and smooth continuation across lattice cells. The proof combines renormalized energy, Schur complement estimates, analytic infinite-tail bounds, interval arithmetic, and exact integer positivity certificates. All finite input data, verification programs, and recorded certificate outputs are provided in the accompanying certificate archive.
summary:
1. 针对无限正方晶格中反平面裂纹的晶格俘获，作者结合区间算术与解析尾部估计，严格构造了相互作用势φ(t)=(1−e^(−3t²))/6下的连通平衡分支。
2. 单胞段恰含两个非退化二次折叠点，完整能量空间内稳定性依次为稳定、莫尔斯指标一、稳定，两折叠载荷之差严格大于0.00296。
3. 端点的精确平移闭合保证分支逐格光滑延拓，确立了该模型中严格为正的裂纹俘获载荷区间及其随晶格平移重复的稳定性结构。

title: Bistable waves and propagation success on hexagonal lattice
abstract: Inspired by propagation phenomena occurring on media with hexagonal structures, we propose an idealized system of bistable reaction-diffusion equations posed on a hexagonal lattice, and investigate the existence and speed of traveling wave solutions. We establish a sharp criterion for propagation success (nonzero wave speed) and failure (zero wave speed), where the criterion is determined by an angle-dependent periodic threshold function and the ratio of two parameters in the nonlinearity. Moreover, the sign of the wave speeds is governed by the angle and the parameter ratio. Our results imply that the hexagonal structure and bistability significantly affect the propagation dynamics.
summary:
1. 作者在六角晶格的分段线性双稳态反应扩散模型中解析构造行波，确定反应阈值α与高稳态β如何控制前沿传播成败。
2. 沿晶格矢量方向，非零波速存在且唯一的充要条件为|α/β−1/2|>γ(θ)，其中角阈值γ具有π/3周期。
3. 结果揭示晶格几何与双稳态共同导致方向选择性钉扎，而可传播前沿的波速符号由α/β偏离平衡值1/2的方向决定。

title: Equilibrium finiteness and Saari's conjecture for the planar circular restricted N-body problem
abstract: We establish two results for planar Newtonian centers in uniform rotation. First, the associated quadratic-plus-Newtonian amended potential has finitely many equilibria for every finite configuration of at least two distinct centers with positive masses. Second, every collision-free planar test-particle motion with constant amended potential, equivalently constant rotating-frame speed, is stationary in the rotating frame. When the centers are primary bodies in a circular relative equilibrium, this proves the amended-potential form of Saari's conjecture for the restricted \(N\)-body problem.
summary:
1. 针对至少两个互异正质量中心的平面匀速旋转系统，作者以复距离覆盖上的代数曲线分析解决了平衡点有限性与恒定修正势运动的刚性问题。
2. 任意中心构型的整个复临界集均有限，涵盖退化平衡点，且无碰撞试探粒子的修正势恒定当且仅当其在旋转系静止。
3. 当主星构成圆形相对平衡时，这确立了平面圆型限制性N体问题的修正势版萨里猜想，即旋转系恒速的无碰撞轨道必与主星刚性共转。

title: On the level lines of bilayer potentials with a finite number of harmonics
abstract: We consider ``bilayer'' potentials formed by the superposition of two periodic potentials in a plane. We assume that both potentials share the same rotational symmetry and employ an approximation involving a finite number of harmonics in their Fourier expansions. An analysis of the level lines of the resulting quasiperiodic potential (a problem posed by S.P. Novikov) near the percolation threshold makes it possible to describe the behavior of large-scale closed level lines in this limit. The results presented here can also be applied to broader classes of bilayer potentials that possess ``good'' analytical properties.
summary:
1. 作者针对两个具有相同三、四或六重旋转对称性的有限谐波周期势之叠加，利用周期逼近与拓扑交数，推导准周期势在渗流阈值附近闭合等势线的尺寸界。
2. 在一般性条件下，存在趋零序列Δ_s，使|c−c₀|>Δ_s时统一有D≤CΔ_s⁻³，将既有五次幂估计改进为序列意义下的三次幂上界。
3. 这一几何约束无需反射对称性，适用于二维电子与超冷原子体系中的有限谐波双层人工势，为比较不同势的渗流性质提供依据。

title: Colored Jones polynomial of figure eight knot and non-perturbative topological recursion
abstract: The asymptotic expansion of the colored Jones polynomial of the figure eight knot is proved to be connected with non-perturbative topological recursion on the underlying elliptic spectral curve, following the proposal of Borot and Eynard.
summary:
1. 作者结合鞍点分析与量子递推，证明八字结着色Jones多项式的局域一致大颜色数渐近展开与几何分支上的非微扰拓扑递归对应。
2. 匹配经典作用量与单圈振幅后，两种波函数的对数微分在所有阶上相等，证明关键是将椭圆谱曲线上的非微扰递归约化为亏格零商曲线上的局域递归。
3. 这确立了从经典A多项式重建该结高阶量子修正的严格途径，所得形式波函数也满足量子A多项式方程。

title: Schwinger-Dyson recursion, Gröbner elimination and graph combinatorics
abstract: Schwinger-Dyson equations are a cornerstone of quantum field theory (QFT). Derived using integration by parts, they capture relations between correlators of different orders, forming an open, infinite-dimensional system. In zero-dimensional QFTs with polynomial actions, which is just a physical interpretation for multivariate Gaussian integrals with polynomial insertions, conventional Gröbner elimination can be used to express all higher-order correlators (moments) in terms of a fixed basis set. One consequence is a closed finite-dimensional system of differential equations for the coupling dependence of these `master' correlators. An important application of zero-dimensional QFTs is in counting discrete geometric structures (as in simplicial approaches to quantum gravity). For the problem of counting labelled regular graphs, applying this Schwinger-Dyson closure results in a computational breakthrough relative to the existing state-of-the-art: for 9- and 10-regular graphs on $n$ vertices, a finite-depth, finite-width recursive formulation is obtained, making it possible to compute the total graph counts in $O(n)$ arithmetic operations.
summary:
1. 作者用交换Gröbner消元组织零维多项式场论的施温格–戴森恒等式，在主基有限时将无限关联函数层级化为闭合微分方程。
2. 该方法将简单标号正则图的定深、定宽精确递推推进至9度和10度，使固定度数下n顶点图的计数仅需O(n)次算术运算。
3. 所得百顶点精确计数超越此前计算范围，展示了高斯积分表示与关联函数闭合相结合在离散结构枚举中的实用价值。

title: Fundamental Symmetries in Krein Spaces
abstract: We study the space of fundamental symmetries of a real or complex Krein space in finite or infinite dimension. After recalling the equivalence of the associated Hilbert norms, we describe two global operator parametrizations and their relation. The space is realized as a Banach symmetric space under $m(J,J')=JJ'J$. Its canonical connection is the tangential projection of the flat derivative in the real Banach space of Krein-self-adjoint operators. This yields explicit formulas for geodesics, parallel transport, transvections, and curvature. The positive square roots $(JJ')^{1/2}$ implement both isometries between the associated Hilbert spaces and geodesic transvections. A proof of their intertwining property in an earlier publication is corrected.
summary:
1. 作者研究同一不定内积对应的不同希尔伯特结构，将任意维实或复克雷因空间的基本对称全体实现为巴拿赫对称空间。
2. 典范联络由平直导数的切向投影给出，任意两点间存在唯一测地线且联络测地完备，并导出平行移动及双对易子形式的曲率公式。
3. 正平方根算符 (JJ′)^{1/2} 同时实现相应希尔伯特空间间的满射等距映射与测地平移，建立了希尔伯特化与基本对称仿射几何的直接联系。

title: The transverse spin-gradient approximation in noncollinear spin density functional theory
abstract:
We prove a quantitative error bound for a fixed-axis variant of the transverse spin-gradient approximation (TSGA) in noncollinear spin density functional theory. Inspired by Eich and Gross, we use a spin-spiral wave (SSW) as the local reference for the grand-canonical Levy-Lieb energy with the Hartree term subtracted. We construct the thermodynamic limit of the electron gas with constant total density and a prescribed SSW magnetization. Its energy per unit volume $e_{m SSW}$ is evaluated at the local wavevector $
abla\varphi$, where $\varphi$ is the spiral phase. When $\varphi$ is the azimuthal angle of the magnetization $\mathbf{m}=(m_1,m_2,m_3)$, the approximation reads \[ E(ho,\mathbf{m})\approx\int_{\mathbb{R}^3}e_{m SSW} ig(ho(\mathbf{x}),\mathbf{m}(\mathbf{x}),
abla\varphi(\mathbf{x}) ig)\,d \mathbf{x}. \] Here $
abla\varphi$ measures the local rotation of $\mathbf{m}$ about the third axis. Wherever $m_1^2+m_2^2>0$, it equals $(m_1
abla m_2-m_2
abla m_1)/(m_1^2+m_2^2)$. The approximation thus depends only on the total density $ho$, the magnetization and its first derivatives. When the spin-polarized density in the rotating frame and the local wavevector vary on the length scale $N^{1/3}$, with $N$ the mean number of particles, we obtain an error $O(N^{5/6})$ for an energy of order $N$. Setting the phase to zero gives the noncollinear local spin density approximation (LSDA) for arbitrary magnetization directions.
summary:
1. 作者以自旋螺旋电子气为局域参照，证明了非共线自旋密度泛函理论中固定轴横向自旋梯度近似的定量误差界。
2. 对于扣除哈特里项的巨正则能量，当旋转系自旋极化密度与局域波矢在N^{1/3}长度尺度上变化时，量级为N的能量误差为O(N^{5/6})，其中N为平均粒子数。
3. 该界确立了这一近似的渐近控制，螺旋相位置零时还恢复适用于任意磁化方向的非共线局域自旋密度近似。

title: Backpropagation as Dirac-bracket dynamics of dissipative training
abstract: Gradient-based training of a parametric model is the motion of a damped particle in the potential set by the loss. Using the Bateman-Galley doubling of the degrees of freedom, which gives dissipative systems an action principle, we write gradient flow, the heavy-ball method and Nesterov's accelerated gradient method as Hamiltonian systems. We show that, within this Hamiltonian description, backpropagation is Dirac evolution. The activations of a feed-forward network are treated as coordinates of phase space, and the layer equations as constraints. These constraints are second class for every architecture, and Hamilton's equations with the resulting Dirac bracket reproduce training with the exact gradient of the loss, although the Hamiltonian contains only the cost of the network output. The Dirac bracket of an activation with the momenta of the parameters is its Jacobian, the inverse of the constraint matrix contains both the forward and the reverse modes of automatic differentiation, and the errors propagated by backpropagation are the Lagrange multipliers of the layer constraints: the constraint forces of a kinematic chain under the load of the cost. These results hold in the full doubled phase space, not only in the physical limit. The network's part of the constraint algebra is the same for every optimizer, Nesterov's look-ahead adds one layer of momentum-dependent constraints that couple the two copies of the doubled system, and gradient flow is obtained by constructing the Dirac bracket in stages. We confirm these statements numerically to machine precision and train a network by integrating the Dirac flow of its constraints, with no backward pass in the computation.
summary:
1. 为解释耗散训练中梯度的动力学来源，作者通过自由度加倍将连续时间优化器哈密顿化，并以第二类约束表示前馈网络。
2. 狄拉克括号在完整加倍相空间生成精确梯度，小型网络的约束流训练无需显式反向传播，与常规训练吻合至10⁻¹¹量级。
3. 约束矩阵的逆统一编码正、反向自动微分，传播误差对应代价负载下运动链的约束力，揭示了所考察优化器共享的网络微分结构。

title: Distribution of the ratio of the two smallest eigenphases of the Jacobi unitary ensemble
abstract: We compute the joint distribution of the two smallest eigenvalues of the Jacobi unitary ensemble and the distribution of their ratio. We use a framework for calculating Janossy densities based on the Tracy-Widom system of ordinary differential equations. For the cases studied here, the leading finite-N correction to the ratio distribution, relative to its universal Bessel-kernel limit, is O(N^{-4}). This behaviour reflects a nontrivial cancellation of lower-order corrections present in the Jacobi kernel. Eigenphase ratios may thus reveal subtle finite-size effects in quantum-chaotic systems with particle-hole or chiral symmetry. As an exploratory arithmetic application, we compare the ratio distribution for the two lowest zeros of quadratic Dirichlet L-functions with the hard-edge limit for Sp(N). The data indicate that the N_{eff}^{-1} term vanishes, leaving an O(N_{eff}^{-2}) correction.
summary:
1. 作者利用Tracy–Widom方程求得有限维雅可比酉系综硬边处两个最小本征相位的联合分布及比值分布。
2. 四组代表性参数的数值结果表明，比值分布相对贝塞尔核极限的首项修正为O(N⁻⁴)，并在勒让德情形解析证实了低阶修正的相消。
3. 这一结果为检验具有粒子—空穴或手征对称性的量子混沌系统中直至N⁻⁴阶的有限尺寸谱普适性提供了随机矩阵基准。

title: Bolognesi's Conjecture for Nonnegative-Charge Iterated Magnetic Bags
abstract: We establish a magnetic-bag limit for smooth $SU(2)$ Bogomolny monopoles associated with finitely many nested smooth surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$. This proves Bolognesi's magnetic-bag conjecture for iterated magnetic bags with nonnegative charge density on each surface.
summary:
1. 作者通过单极子拼接与对角论证，证明了Bolognesi猜想对任意有限组嵌套光滑曲面、各层表面电荷密度非负的迭代磁袋成立。
2. 在拓扑荷与耦合成比例趋于无穷的光滑SU(2) Bogomolny单极子序列中，希格斯模在曲面外局部一致趋于磁袋场，投影曲率在该场为正的曲面外区域光滑收敛。
3. 希格斯模的次调和性还表明，非负表面电荷是此类磁袋极限的必要条件。

title: The Zero Mode Constraint in the Dirac-Bergmann Analysis of Kadomtsev-Petviashvili Type Equations
abstract: We derive the Hamiltonian formulation of the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) equation from a singular Lagrangian by means of the Dirac-Bergmann algorithm. The Lagrangian contains an auxiliary field, which leads to an irregular secondary constraint. On the branch that reproduces the KP equation, all constraints are second class, and the Dirac brackets give the known Hamiltonian and Poisson operator. We confirm these results by the Faddeev-Jackiw method. Then, we consider fields periodic in the first spatial coordinate. In this case, the zero modes of the derivative operator lead to an additional secondary constraint on the mean of the potential. This constraint replaces the inverse derivative by its zero mean counterpart, and the resulting Hamiltonian is in accordance with the one of Reiman and Semenov-Tyan-Shanskii, up to normalization conventions. For decaying fields, the same condition is necessary for rapidly decreasing potentials to remain rapidly decreasing. We show that this constraint appears for a general class of KP-type equations. In addition, we classify the smooth solutions of the auxiliary-field action. We also relate our results to an existing quantization of the KP equation, for which the potential Lagrangian provides an action.
summary:
1. 作者从含辅助场的奇异作用量推导KP分支的哈密顿结构，用狄拉克—伯格曼算法确定周期边界下的零模约束。
2. 纵向周期、横向衰减时，横向色散产生将势均值固定为零的次级约束，由此导出零均值逆导数，并解释已知哈密顿量中均值修正项的约束起源。
3. 这一机制适用于纵向能量仅依赖势的纵向导数的一类KP型方程，表明零模约束及均值修正仅由横向色散决定，与纵向非线性和色散无关。

title: Non-Existence of Eigenvalues and Interface States for the Schrödinger Operator with Longitudinal Interface Potentials
abstract: We consider the Schrödinger operator in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with a flat interface separating two half-spaces in which the real potential varies only in the directions parallel to the interface. This problem generally possesses no shift invariance. Nevertheless, using the method of multipliers, we prove the absence of eigenvalues. In addition, in the case of periodic potentials on each side of the interface the same method shows the absence of interface states which are quasi-periodic in the directions parallel to the interface and localized in the transverse direction.
summary:
1. 针对二维及以上、平直界面两侧有界实势仅沿切向变化的薛定谔算符，作者用乘子法严格证明点谱为空，涵盖缺乏平移对称性的情形。
2. 当两侧势具有共同切向周期时，同一方法进一步排除所有布洛赫波矢下切向准周期、法向局域的界面态。
3. 作者还通过含法向周期调制的可分离势构造出束缚态和界面态，明确了上述普适禁戒对各半空间内法向均匀性的依赖。

title: Discotic columnar phase in a three-dimensional monomer-tetramer model of Heilmann and Lieb with side-to-side attraction
abstract: We study Model III of Heilmann--Lieb (1979), a lattice model for liquid crystals consisting of tetramers (plaquettes) on the cubic lattice at chemical potential $\mu$, interacting via a hard-core repulsion and a lateral attraction of strength $a>0$ between coplanar, aligned tetramers. The model was conjectured to exhibit liquid-crystalline order at low temperature provided that $\mu+2a>0$. We establish discotic columnar order throughout this regime, fully resolving the conjecture. Specifically, we prove the existence of exactly twelve extremal and periodic Gibbs measures, each breaking rotational symmetry, with one of three tetramer orientations dominant, and translational symmetry in exactly two directions, with one of four tetramer parities dominant within that orientation. Thus, the tetramers form one-dimensional columns arranged on a square lattice. This arrangement is not a priori evident from the zero-temperature picture, where energy only enforces a layered structure: each layer is fully packed and crystalline, but different layers are free to shift independently within their planes. The main novelty here lies in showing how thermal fluctuations lift this degeneracy in favor of the twelve ground states in which all tetramers share a common parity.
summary:
1. 作者严格证明，立方晶格硬核单体—四聚体模型在层内侧向吸引强度a>0、化学势满足μ+2a>0的整个区域内，于足够低温形成盘状柱相。
2. 体系恰有十二个极端周期吉布斯态，由三种优势取向与四种面内奇偶类标记，均破缺旋转对称性及恰好两个方向的平移对称性。
3. 相邻层奇偶类一致时容纳更多最低能跨层缺陷，其熵优势同步各层排布并解除基态滑移简并，确立热涨落稳定柱相的无序致有序机制。

title: Slow information spreading in quasi-periodic quantum spin chains
abstract: We investigate the suppression of information propagation in a weakly interacting quantum spin chain subject to a quasi-periodic external magnetic field. Using a finite-order normal-form construction, we establish a localized barrier in the interior of the chain that inhibits information propagation and derive a quantitative bound on the commutator of observables supported at opposite ends of the chain.
summary:
1. 针对确定性准周期磁场如何抑制弱相互作用自旋链的信息传播，作者以有限阶正规形变换构造链内局域屏障，严格推导端到端对易子界。
2. 对任意一致有界的最近邻相互作用，在固定相位并排除小测度共振频率集后，长链的Lieb–Robinson界获得随耦合强度趋零而超幂次减小的额外抑制因子。
3. 这一结果建立了不依赖可积结构的局部信息阻滞机制，作者提出在固定非零耦合下构造任意尺度屏障，以探索全局信息传播抑制。

title: Sharp constant in 2D critical fermionic Hardy inequality
abstract: We study the large-$N$ behavior of the optimal constant $\kappa_N$ in the two-dimensional fermionic many-particle Hardy inequality \[ \sum_{i=1}^N -\Delta_i \geq \kappa_N^{(2)}\sum_{1\leq i<j\leq N}\frac{1}{|x_i-x_j|^2}, \] understood as a quadratic-form inequality on antisymmetric wave functions. We prove that \[ \lim_{N\to\infty}(\log N)\kappa_N^{(2)}=4, \] thereby proving a conjecture of Frank, Hoffmann-Ostenhof, Laptev, and Solovej. The proof combines a dyadic Fefferman-de la Llave representation of the Coulomb kernel with separate estimates for squares of low and high particle occupation. A trace inequality controls the low-occupation regime, while sums of Neumann eigenvalues yield the sharp bound in the high-occupation regime.
summary:
1. 针对二维费米子动能对粒子间反平方势的最优控制，作者结合二进方格分解、近邻估计与局域谱界，确定了临界多体哈代常数的大粒子数渐近行为。
2. 严格证明最优常数满足lim_{N→∞}(log N)κ_N^(2)=4，解决了既有的尖锐常数猜想。
3. 证明揭示，高占据区域的诺伊曼本征值和给出尖锐主导项，反对称性与迹估计控制的低占据贡献仅产生与粒子数无关的有界修正。

title: Sharp one-shot bounds and optimal exponents of universal randomness extraction
abstract: We introduce techniques for the study of randomness extraction against quantum side information (privacy amplification) by relating this problem to variants of hypothesis testing tasks with quadratic constraints. Building also on the recently introduced measured smooth entropy approach of [Regula and Tomamichel, arXiv:2603.04493 ], we precisely determine the optimal scaling of the error of quantum privacy amplification in several regimes. Our results apply to the standard operational security criterion based on trace distance and focus in particular on universal classes of hash functions. On the technical side, our investigation reveals connections with operator space theory methods used in non-commutative Khintchine inequalities. As one application, we give a one-shot converse bound that shows the leftover hash lemma of [ arXiv:2603.04493 ] to be tight up to a constant factor for all strongly 4-universal hash functions. This allows us to evaluate the asymptotic i.i.d. error exponent of universal randomness extraction for all rates, matching the bound of [Dupuis, arXiv:2105.05342 ] and improving also earlier classical asymptotic results of [Hayashi, arXiv:1010.1358 ]. We furthermore give new one-shot achievability and converse bounds on the error in the strong converse regime, which we show to match up to a constant factor. This establishes the exact strong converse exponent of quantum privacy amplification under 2-universal hash functions, complementing the converse bound of [Shen, Gao, and Cheng, arXiv:2202.10263 ].
summary:
1. 作者将量子旁信息下普适隐私放大的迹距离误差联系到带二次约束的假设检验，建立单次可达界与逆界。
2. 对4*普适哈希，剩余哈希引理在三倍因子内紧致，由此确定该类哈希在独立同分布情形下的全速率误差指数，并求得2普适哈希的精确强逆指数。
3. 误差衰减和误差趋于一的指数分别由夹心型与Petz型Rényi条件熵决定，刻画了相应普适哈希类的渐近安全性标度。

title: Gauge symmetry permits extremely low-depth random unitary circuits
abstract: Continuous global symmetries can obstruct logarithmic-depth symmetric unitary $k$-designs and pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs) through long-range correlations. We ask whether gauge symmetries impose analogous limitations. For $\mathrm{U}(1)$ lattice gauge theories, we identify a randomization scale $c$, the minimum patch size needed for matter to screen every allowed boundary-flux mismatch, and a diffusive scale governing boundary-flux correlations. Glued circuits built from gauge-symmetric unitaries with subdiffusive support are efficiently distinguishable from gauge-symmetric Haar-random unitaries, whereas local controlled designs can be glued into global approximate designs when overlaps exceed the diffusive scale multiplied by a logarithmic factor. Our analysis suggests incomplete screening limits design guarantees to constant order, whereas strictly locally random systems with complete local screening ($c=1$) admit a local tensor-product description, permitting superpolynomial design orders and logarithmic-depth designs and PRUs. We construct a toy model of charged black-hole evaporation in which insufficient screening makes uninterrupted complete discharge exponentially unlikely in $c$, whereas strict local randomization removes this screening obstruction. This motivates a quantum-information analogue of the weak gravity conjecture, requiring the available charged spectrum to support complete local screening in addition to superextremality. We conjecture that this condition allows gauge-symmetric systems to scramble as rapidly as unconstrained ones and support this by constructing logarithmic-depth approximate strong designs and strong PRUs.
summary:
1. 作者研究一维U(1)格点规范理论中规范约束对快速随机化的影响，建立了由物质电荷屏蔽控制的随机酉线路拼接定理。
2. 局域块小于扩散尺度时，拼接线路可与规范对称Haar随机演化高效区分；完全单点屏蔽且链路为量子比特时，全连接规范不变线路以对数深度实现固定阶近似强酉设计。
3. 蒸发玩具模型表明，完全局域屏蔽也消除了不间断放电的多体屏蔽障碍，为联系带电黑洞有效放电与快速扰乱的猜想提供支持。

title: When does a noisy Bell pair attain the Rains bound?
abstract: Two entangled Bell-diagonal qubit states with the same singlet fraction have the same Rains bound. We prove that their attainable rates under operations preserving the positive partial transpose can nevertheless differ: the bound is attained if and only if one of the Bell probabilities vanishes. Every mixed entangled isotropic state, in every finite dimension, lies strictly below its bound. This refutes the attainment suggested by finite-block numerics, and places the two-way quantum capacity of the qubit depolarizing channel strictly below its relative-entropy bound.
summary:
1. 作者利用未占据子空间构造阈值检验，并建立复解析逆界，判定了纠缠双量子比特贝尔对角态在正部分转置保持操作下达到Rains界的条件。
2. 达到该界当且仅当至少一个贝尔概率为零；满秩态存在严格渐近速率缺口，速率超过所得上界时最优保真度随块长指数衰减。
3. 任意有限维混合纠缠各向同性态也存在严格缺口，从而证明乔伊态混合且纠缠的量子比特去极化信道，其双向量子容量严格低于PLOB相对熵界。

title: Quantum Copy Complexity of Testing Monotonicity and Other Properties
abstract: We study the sample complexity of testing monotonicity of Boolean functions when the tester is given only copies of the quantum function state $|\psi_f\rangle=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2^n}}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}|x,f(x)\rangle$. We give a tester with sample complexity $O\left(\min\left\{\frac{n}{\varepsilon^3}, \frac{n^{3/2}}{\varepsilon^2}\right\}\right)$, improving on the previous $\widetilde O(n^2/\varepsilon^2)$ upper bound of [CNS26]. We also prove the first nontrivial lower bounds for monotonicity testing from quantum function states, matching our upper bounds over a broad range of $\varepsilon$. Our upper bounds use two approaches. The first approach refines the Fourier-based tester of [CNS26] by handling high-influence functions separately, adapting an idea from [KMS18]. The second approach uses the classical path tester of [KMS18] by constructing a quantum observable whose expectation equals the path tester's violation probability. To prove the lower bounds, we place independent functions in mutually incomparable regions of the Boolean hypercube, building on the classical constructions of [BB16, CWX17]. We introduce a new argument for the quantum setting that replaces a fixed number of copies with a Poisson-distributed number of copies, allowing the contributions from different regions to be analyzed independently. This same framework also allows us to prove an $\Omega(n^2)$ lower bound for testing union-closedness and $2$-monotonicity from quantum function states.
summary:
1. 作者研究仅凭均匀量子函数态副本区分单调布尔函数与距单调性至少ε的函数，通过傅里叶采样和路径观测量构建检验，并以相干泊松化证明下界。
2. 当 \(2^{-\sqrt n/200}\le\varepsilon\le1/128\) 时，成功率至少为2/3的最优副本复杂度为 \(\Theta(\min\{n/\varepsilon^3,n^{3/2}/\varepsilon^2\})\)，上下界匹配。
3. 这些下界适用于任意联合测量，同一框架还证明在 \(0<\varepsilon\le1/256\) 时，并集封闭性和2-单调性检验均需 \(\Omega(n^2)\) 个副本，确立了相应的量子样本资源限制。

title: How Many Keys Must a Quantum Computer Break to Take Over a Blockchain? A Quantum Nakamoto Coefficient for Fifteen Proof-of-Stake Networks
abstract: Blockchains that run on proof of stake, among them Ethereum and Solana, are secured by a vote: a transaction becomes irreversible once computers holding two thirds of the deposited money have signed it. Each signature is made with a secret key whose public counterpart is permanently visible, and a large quantum computer could compute the secret from the public key. We ask a simple question: how many such keys would it have to break to take over the vote? We call the answer the quantum Nakamoto coefficient and measure it on live data from fifteen networks, collected on 15 November 2026. For fourteen of them, 2 to 18 keys are enough to break the network's security guarantee and 7 to 77 to control it outright; at one key every 12 minutes, the pace implied by recent resource estimates, a single quantum computer would defeat the guarantee of any of these networks in less than four hours and take full control in less than sixteen hours. Ethereum is far more robust, but a 2025 change that lets operators merge their deposits into fewer keys has cut the number of keys at its first threshold from about 465,000 to 7,682, a factor of 60. We derive a simple formula for this effect, and another for the small rotating committee on which wallets rely, and confirm both on the data. For fourteen of the fifteen networks, the first large quantum computer would be less than a day away from total control. Their validator signatures should therefore be migrated to post-quantum schemes before such a machine exists, since once it does, the time to respond is measured in hours.
summary:
1. 作者定义量子中本聪系数，利用十五个权益证明网络的投票权重快照，计算Shor攻击跨越共识阈值所需破解的最少签名密钥数。
2. 十四个网络跨越三分之一和三分之二投票权阈值分别仅需2—18和7—77把密钥；以太坊质押合并使前一门槛降至7682把，约为同总质押按32 ETH分键时的1/60。
3. 结果将量子攻击成本与密钥间的质押分布定量联系起来，支持在具备攻击能力的量子计算机出现前，优先将大权重验证者签名迁移至后量子方案。

title: Estimating the Trotter error via phase analysis
abstract: Good Trotter error estimates are crucial to correctly assess the resources required to perform an approximate time evolution with a target accuracy. General bounds for finite-size quantum systems are found to be very loose in practice, and it is therefore highly desirable to improve on them. In this work, we analyze the Trotter error in terms of the spectrum of a phase operator that we construct from the Hamiltonian. In the limit of a small Trotter step size, we obtain an estimate of the Trotter error written in terms of a sum of nested commutators between terms of the Hamiltonian. The structure of this estimate allows us to naturally explain the looseness of general bounds. We show that even for a finite step size, our estimate typically remains more accurate than general bounds. Moreover, we argue that it becomes an upper bound for the Trotter error per step in the limit of a large number of steps, reflecting the destructive interference of the errors across steps. Our results provide useful practical heuristics for resource optimization in quantum simulations.
summary:
1. 针对量子时间演化的Trotter误差估算，作者构造相位算符，将其谱与算符距离及不保真度关联，并推导小步长下的误差主项。
2. 一阶公式的误差主项由对易子总和的范数决定，项间抵消解释了通用界偏松，三、六量子比特数值计算显示该估计在有限步长下通常更准确。
3. 多步分析与数值结果揭示跨步相消干涉对每步误差的抑制，支持在步数较大时以该估计作为实用上界，为量子模拟资源优化提供启发式依据。

title: A Realistic End-to-End Runtime Crossover Estimation for Quantum-Enhanced Training of Large-Scale Machine Learning Models
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is one promising application domain for Quantum Computing (QC) speedups, but asymptotic complexity considerations often mask the actual engineering costs of actual end-to-end workflows. For the use case of training a linearized Neural Network with a Quantum Linear Solver, a provably favorable quantum scaling has been suggested. We present realistic resource estimates for this problem, accounting for data access, computation, and readout. Our analysis examines three increasingly complex benchmarking scenarios, under distinct sparsity-scaling assumptions, thereby enabling progressively more realistic resource estimates. We identify crossover regimes relative to classical methods and find that crossover points emerge only for very large problem sizes, long computation times, and highly restrictive output requirements. This work provides a blueprint for evaluating quantum-enhanced ML algorithms under realistic hardware constraints and help identifying the bottlenecks that must be overcome to approach industrial quantum utility.
summary:
1. 针对神经网络训练的量子加速，作者在完全耗散假设下建立Carleman线性化方案的三级资源模型，计入HHL求解、态制备、读出及梯度预处理。
2. 在串行CPU基准及仅读出100个归一化权重振幅的设定下，完整流程相对随机梯度下降的耗时交叉点估为约10^21个参数、超过10^20秒。
3. 层析使量子求解成本随输出支持数五次增长，梯度预处理引入随参数数目线性增长的成本，明确了该方案实现实用量子优势的两个主要瓶颈。

title: Dimensional crossover to a slow disordered spin bath below the mean spin spacing
abstract: How thin must a layer of spins be to act as a two-dimensional bath? For nitrogen spins around an NV$^-$ centre in diamond, a cluster expansion with flip-flopping outer spins gives a crossover near the mean spin spacing. Thin layers follow two-dimensional scaling with a prefactor six to seven times that of bulk. Without hyperfine disorder the crossover remains but the step is under three: the disorder leaves each spin almost no resonant partner. Flip-flops allow several milliseconds, so another process must set the measured 0.5 ms; nitrogen spin-lattice relaxation is consistent.
summary:
1. 作者用含自旋对翻转动力学的团簇展开，确定金刚石NV⁻周围P1自旋浴的三维至二维交叉发生在层厚接近平均自旋间距时。
2. 薄层翻转受限相干时间按面密度的−3/2次幂缩放，相同平均间距下达体相的六至七倍，其中超精细分组通过抑制共振产生超出几何效应的减速。
3. 翻转动力学允许数毫秒相干，加入P1自旋晶格弛豫后计算接近实测约0.5毫秒，提示浴弛豫可成为二维层的相干瓶颈。

title: Improved Quantum Algorithms for TSP and More
abstract: The traveling salesman problem (TSP) is a canonical NP-hard optimization problem. For general edge weights, the classical dynamic programs of Bellman and of Held and Karp solve TSP on $n$ cities in $O^*(2^n)$ time. To date, no $\Oh(c^n)$-time classical algorithm is known for any $c<2$. Combining Grover search with the dynamic programming technique, Ambainis et al. (SODA 2019) introduced a quantum algorithm with running time $O^*(1.7274^n)$, which is still the best known quantum time bound. In this work, we improve the running time to $O^*(1.70961^n)$. The core idea of our algorithm is to combine the framework of Ambainis et al. with the extremal set-system framework, which was recently used for classical space-time tradeoffs of TSP by Jabal Ameli, Nederlof and Wang (FOCS 2026) and Dallant and Kozma (FOCS 2026). To obtain our upper bound, we decompose the optimal tour into four consecutive subpaths of different sizes, for which, based on the idea of set-systems, the optimal values are computed using dynamic programming with small success probability and use amplitude amplification. Using the same idea, we also give a new quantum space-time tradeoff for TSP, improving the previous results of Caroppo et al. (ESA 2026) and Dallant ( arXiv:2607.12374 ). Finally, we obtain the same quantum upper bounds for several other related problems.
summary:
1. 针对整数边权有向及无向旅行商问题，作者在量子随机存取内存模型下，结合不等长四段路径分解、极值集合系动态规划与振幅放大，构造有界误差优化算法。

title: QPAT: A Universal Quantum Machine Learning Framework for Quantum-Assisted Training and Classical Inference
abstract: Deep learning models often struggle with sharp local optima and overfitting in limited-data regimes, and exhibit limited capacity for capturing high-order, complex probability distributions. Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models, by operating in exponentially large Hilbert spaces, can efficiently represent such distributions and provide favorable inductive biases for learning, offering a promising pathway to overcome these limitations. However, their practical deployment in the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era is severely hindered by gradient coupling, barren plateaus, data-loading bottlenecks, and high inference latency. To bridge classical AI and QML, we propose QPAT (QCBM-Prior-Assisted Training), a universal framework that employs a Quantum Circuit Born Machine (QCBM) as a learnable generative prior to provide a task-aligned structured inductive bias during classical model training. The framework can be seamlessly integrated into any classical backbone, including LSTMs, CNNs, and Transformers. We introduce a decoupled fitness-based scoring mechanism and a stochastic "Drop-Prior" mechanism to implicitly distill quantum structural knowledge into the classical weights during training. Evaluated extensively on six benchmarks spanning time-series forecasting, computer vision, and natural language processing, our framework consistently outperforms purely classical backbones in both predictive performance and stability across random seeds; ablation studies further show that these gains are not reproduced by unstructured random priors or a classically learned generative prior. Remarkably, our approach enables completely classical inference, bypassing quantum latency while preserving quantum-enhanced accuracy, paving a highly practical path for QML deployment.

title: Efficient Quantum Algorithm for the Generalised Geography Game
abstract: The Generalized Geography Game ($GGG$) is a two-player combinatorial game played on a directed graph, where players alternately move a token along edges without revisiting previously visited vertices. In the existing literature, determining whether an arbitrary position in a graph is a winning position for either player is a well-known $PSPACE$-complete decision problem. Certain formulations of $GGG$ have been shown to fall outside the $PSPACE$-complete complexity class. While $PSPACE$-complete problems are believed to take exponential time for classical computation, quantum computation offers new possibilities. In this work, we present a bounded-error quantum polynomial-time ($BQP$) algorithm for solving the $GGG$ problem. The proposed algorithm runs in time $O(N^{2}/\epsilon^{6})$, which is polynomial in the input size $N$, and achieves bounded error with $\epsilon = O(1/\mathrm{poly}(N))$. This result demonstrates the potential of quantum algorithms to efficiently solve combinatorial game problems that are traditionally considered computationally hard in the classical setting.

title: Reproducible distributions of energy-relaxation times in superconducting qubits from broadband SWAP spectroscopy
abstract: The distribution of the qubit energy-relaxation time (T1) in a superconducting quantum processor affects its logical error rates. However, reports on qubit fabrication quality focus on the median or best-case T1 from measurements that are not reproducible due to resonant coupling to two-level system (TLS) defects whose frequencies fluctuate in time. Here, we sweep the frequency f01 of a flux-tunable qubit over several GHz with SWAP spectroscopy, quoting the quality factor Q = 2 pi f01 T1 to make T1 comparable across frequencies. We show that the cumulative distribution of Q pooled over the sweep is reproducible across four thermal cycles spanning 326 days, up to the reshuffling of strongly coupled TLSs. In contrast to repeated measurements at a single frequency, the medians of the broadband Q distributions spread by an order of magnitude less over 3 days. The distance between the cumulative distributions of repeats comes close to its sampling floor only for the broadband sweeps. The broadband Q distribution further resolves small coherence differences between identically designed qubits on two dies of the same wafer. These results establish the broadband Q distribution as a reproducible metric for qubit fabrication quality.

2. 等时比较中，仅宽带分布三天内的KS距离中位数0.03接近采样下限0.02；跨326天四次热循环的分布差异来自强耦合缺陷重排，背景保持稳定。

title: Decoherent Histories from Local Spectral Dephasing in Quantum Many-Body Systems
abstract: We study local spectral dephasing as a mechanism for decoherent histories in isolated quantum many-body systems. We prove that vanishing projector-weighted spectral concentration is asymptotically equivalent to vanishing time-averaged local memory. With independently sampled waiting times and suitable conditions on the initial state and history weights, this local property suppresses normalized interference across complete fixed-length history families with high probability. For translation-invariant lattices, spectral estimates provide conditions under which dephasing occurs at long times. Exact diagonalization and sparse time evolution of a spin chain illustrate the results.

title: Empirical De-Quantization and Norm-Controlled Spectral Audit of Quantum Cognition Machine Learning in an Emerging Equity Market
abstract: Quantum-inspired machine learning in econophysics describes states of financial markets through matrix Hamiltonians, using ground-state expectations to predict returns and spectral gaps to identify crises. Although early work reports encouraging advances, it remains unclear whether these stem from genuine noncommutative quantum geometry or from conventional classical regularization and scale effects. We test this in a controlled audit of matrix-form Quantum Cognition Machine Learning (QCML) and variational quantum circuits on the Moscow Exchange (2020-2025), combining daily equity data with causally lagged macro news under realistic trading costs, short-selling bans, and abrupt shifts in market regimes. By using capacity-matched operator swaps -- which progressively eliminate complex Berry phases and matrix noncommutativity down to a commuting classical Gibbs radial-basis limit under scale-invariant regularization -- as well as testing spectral indicators against radial-norm null hypotheses and untrained GUE random matrices, we isolate the contribution of each quantum element. In out-of-sample data, neither complex phases, noncommutativity, nor circuit entanglement improves the ranking of returns relative to classical controls. Once feature magnitudes are normalized, apparent crisis detection from raw spectral gaps drops below chance levels. These results show that on noisy equity panels, matrix-form QCML acts as an adaptive spectrally bounded classical smoothing kernel: it reliably integrates lagged news and curbs extreme crisis forecasts without passing economic multiple-testing thresholds, while our audit provides operator-swap and random-matrix controls for evaluating future quantum-inspired financial models.

title: Gaussian Is All You Need: Renyi Optimizers and Optical Channel Simulation
abstract: Preparing an entangled state faithfully requires an amount of resource given by its entanglement cost. With less entanglement, the best achievable fidelity is governed by the Rényi entanglement of formation of orders above one. We prove that, for any finite-energy multimode bosonic Gaussian state, all these quantities are additive and attained by a Gaussian pure-state decomposition. It follows that the closest separable state in fidelity to any Gaussian state is Gaussian, and that the strong converse exponent of entanglement dilution, which sets how fast the optimal fidelity decays below the cost, is exactly computable. For channels, we prove that pure Gaussian inputs minimize the output Rényi entropies of every multimode Gaussian channel at all orders $\alpha\ge1$, and we obtain the optimal fidelity of simulating pure-loss and quantum-limited amplifier channels with finite entanglement, for any number of uses.
summary:

title: Unified preparation of exact and asymptotic quantum many-body scars from Dicke states
abstract: We propose a unified quantum algorithm for preparing exact and asymptotic quantum many-body scar (QMBS) states in the spin-1 {\it XY}, domain-wall-conserving, and Onsager scar models. Model-dependent isometries map the exact scar states to Dicke states and the target asymptotic QMBS states to gapless magnon excitations of the spin-1/2 ferromagnetic Heisenberg chain. Exact QMBS states are prepared by applying the inverse isometries to Dicke states. For asymptotic QMBS states, block encoding first prepares the magnon excitations from Dicke states to a prescribed fidelity, after which the inverse isometries map the prepared states back to the physical chains. At fixed target fidelity, the block-encoding success probability has a positive lower bound independent of system size and scar index, implying that a constant number of amplitude amplification rounds suffices. Our algorithm enables systematic studies of nonergodic dynamics on programmable quantum simulators.

title: Discrete truncated Wigner approximation of the quantum phase transition in the transverse-field Ising model
abstract: The discrete truncated Wigner approximation (DTWA) has been a workhorse for large-scale spin dynamics, but whether it captures dynamics across a quantum phase transition has not been tested systematically. In this work, we use the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) to study the quantum phase transition with DTWA from one to three dimensions and with all-to-all connectivity, using slow linear ramps and fast ramps. We find that DTWA cannot capture the dynamics on the one-dimensional chain, and that its behavior is consistent with classical thermalization, in which its classical spins relax toward a thermal state at a finite effective temperature that does not vanish for slow ramps, while a one-dimensional chain cannot order at any finite temperature. For square and cubic lattices, in contrast to the chain, DTWA builds order, and the order sets in close to the quantum critical point found by quantum Monte Carlo (QMC). However, its correlations do not grow with the Kibble-Zurek exponents, so DTWA captures the onset of order but not the universal dynamics of the transition. For all-to-all coupling, DTWA follows the exact growth of the order parameter along the entire ramp. Our results suggest that DTWA becomes more reliable as each spin interacts with more partners, and that beyond one dimension it can indicate where a quantum phase transition lies but cannot capture its critical scaling.

title: Minimal input dimension for superactivation of one-shot zero-error quantum capacity
abstract: The one-shot zero-error quantum capacity $\overline{Q}_0$ is studied within the framework of noncommutative graphs of quantum channels. The additivity of $\overline{Q}_0$ is proved for an arbitrary finite collection of channels with two-dimensional input spaces. An explicit pair of noncommutative graphs $S,T\subset M_3$ exhibiting superactivation of the one-shot zero-error quantum capacity is also constructed. Together, these results establish that the minimum input dimension for such superactivation is $3$.

title: Prethermalization of entanglement entropy in the mixed-field Ising model
abstract: We study how weak integrability breaking affects the dynamics of the half-chain entanglement entropy of random product states in the mixed-field Ising model. The associated Hamiltonian depends on two parameters $g$ and $h$ determining the sizes of the longitudinal and transverse fields and has two integrable limits: the classical Ising chain $(h=0)$ and the transverse-field Ising model $(g=0)$. Weak perturbations of these limits give rise to the short-range network (SRN) and long-range network (LRN) regimes, respectively. We characterize the departure from integrable dynamics and the emergence of intermediate entanglement plateaus by melting times $T_M$ at prescribed entropy thresholds and analyze their dependence on the perturbation strength. For the SRN parameters examined away from $g=2$, we find $T_M\propto h^{-2}$ over the thresholds tested. At $g=2$, the relaxation splits into two stages: an initial departure from the integrable plateau with $T_M\propto h^{-1}$, followed by the melting of a well-defined intermediate prethermal plateau with $T_{M_2}\propto h^{-2}$. In the LRN regime, by contrast, the inverse of $T_M$ scales with exponents of $g$ close to either one or two, depending on the parameter values, the system size, and the entropy threshold, and no well-defined prethermal plateaus are observed. Our analysis distinguishes the melting of integrable dynamics from the subsequent decay of a prethermal plateau, which is observed in the SRN regime.

title: A Path Integral Method with Far-Field Expansion for Open Quantum Dynamics
abstract: We establish a connection between the quasi-adiabatic propagator path integral (QuAPI) method and fast resummation of Dyson series (FRODS). Building on this connection, we introduce a path integral method with far-field expansion (PIFFE) for quantum systems coupled linearly to a thermal Gaussian bath. PIFFE combines QuAPI with a Taylor expansion of the far-field bath influence, keeping interactions within $r$ time steps in exponential form. The scheme has error $O(\Delta t^2)$ at fixed final time and is free of stochastic or tensor-compression errors. Spin-boson tests show that PIFFE gives results much closer to QuAPI than FRODS does, even for small $r$, while requiring substantially less storage than QuAPI. This allows much longer bath memory lengths and simulations of multilevel systems. Truncating the bath memory and limiting the total auxiliary degree further reduce storage and computational costs.

2. 全记忆且无总阶数截断时算法具有二阶时间精度，自旋—玻色子测试较FRODS更接近QuAPI，十一能级、50步记忆算例的峰值内存为1.35 GiB。

title: Beyond-quantum correlations for single system in pseudo-quantum model
abstract: Within the standard prepare-measure framework, it has been demonstrated that certain compositions of two elementary quantum systems can produce beyond-quantum correlations and can even lead to perfect discrimination of two non-orthogonal quantum states. In this Letter, we introduce the pseudo-quantum model (PQM) for a single system that incorporates the \emph{pseudo-states (effects)} (they satisfy all the properties of quantum states and effects except having negative eigenvalues), and yields valid probability. We consider a prepare-measure communication game known as random access code (RAC) and demonstrate that the success probability achievable within PQM exceeds the corresponding optimal quantum success probability, thereby giving rise to beyond-quantum correlations even for a single system. We then show that such correlations are unphysical as they violate the information causality (IC) principle. Moreover, we demonstrate that two non-orthogonal states can be perfectly distinguishable in PQM for a single system. Therefore, we demonstrate that for a single indivisible system (devoid of any composition), the negativity of \emph{pseudo-states (effects)} can lead to the emergence of beyond-quantum correlations.

title: Scaling laws for quantum reflection of hydrogen isotopes on silicon
abstract: Quantum reflection is a counter-intuitive process occurring when an atom is reflected by a rapidly-varying attraction towards a surface, for example the Casimir-Polder force. The reflection probability depends on the attractive potential and on the mass of the atom. For hydrogen isotopes, the potentials are nearly identical whereas significant differences in quantum reflection come from the effect of atomic mass. We calculate the quantum reflection probability for the three isotopes H, D or T falling onto the plane surface of an intrinsic silicon bulk. We show that the results obey scaling laws determined by scattering lengths calculated from theory. Moreover the scattering lengths also obey scaling laws with respect to atomic masses of the isotopes.

title: Geometry, masking and selection in Differential Evolution and SOMA on quantum state manifolds
abstract: Differential Evolution (DE) and the Self-Organizing Migrating Algorithm (SOMA) generate new candidates through vector arithmetic: they subtract population members, scale the difference, and mask coordinates. Many practical search spaces are not vector spaces, however. Rotation angles are periodic, normalized states lie on spheres and projective spaces, and circuit parameters are coupled through the quantum states they produce. We present a systematic study of how such geometry affects the core operations of DE and SOMA. Keeping the operators and selection rules fixed, we replace only their geometric primitives and separate the effects of difference construction, masking, and selection in a large paired numerical study covering textbook manifolds and variational quantum problems. Geometry-consistent differences make full-crossover (CR = 1) DE significantly better on 16 of 31 non-Euclidean configurations, with no significant deterioration, and the advantage persists when the measured computational cost of each variant is taken into account. The effect is largest where ordinary subtraction misrepresents distances between candidates: success on periodic synchronization rises from 44% to 100%, and on a positive-definite matrix problem from 1% to 99%. On six- qubit variational eigensolvers, shortest-path angular differences reduce the mean final loss by 90% for about 3% extra runtime. The improvements come with two contrasting diversity patterns, more effective population contraction or preserved population diversity, so higher acceptance rates do not necessarily indicate better search. Crossover masks interact with geometry: they can favor cheaper retractions and can increase the distance moved in quantum-state space when circuit parameters are coupled. These results give practical rules for designing population-based optimizers on non-Euclidean and quantum search spaces.

title: Squeezing-preserving coherent control in Fourier-shaped optical lattices
abstract: Motional squeezed states of atoms in optical lattices are affected by the anharmonicity of the trapping potential. Unequal vibrational energy spacings cause dephasing among the occupied motional-state coherences, leading to distortion of the wavepacket and a reduction in squeezing. We show numerically that adding a weak second or third spatial harmonic to a one-dimensional lattice slows the initial decay of the squeezing. Squeezed states are prepared by one or two sudden changes of the lattice depth. For each harmonic and each preparation scheme, we choose the harmonic amplitude that keeps the evolved state closest, on average over 1 ms, to its evolution in a harmonic trap. We then compare the squeezing with that in a sinusoidal lattice with the same initial squeezing and trap frequency. In all four cases studied, the successive squeezing maxima initially decay more slowly in the shaped lattice. The improvement arises because the optimal harmonic nearly equalizes the two dominant vibrational level spacings over the region occupied by the squeezed wave packet, which canceling the quartic term of the potential alone does not achieve. Because the amplitude of the added harmonic is static and can be produced with existing Fourier-synthesis techniques, lattice shaping offers a simple way to preserve motional squeezing without additional time-dependent control.

title: Planckian bounds on thermalization times of strongly coupled open quantum systems
abstract: We consider whether the thermalization of strongly coupled open quantum systems, whose equilibrium state is the mean-force Gibbs (MFG) state, is constrained by a fundamental Planckian time scale, $\hbar/k_B T$. By requiring that the same process thermalizes a family of nearby system Hamiltonians, we obtain a lower bound on the thermalization time, irrespective of the specific system-bath dynamics. The bound depends only on the distinguishability of the corresponding MFG states, and can therefore be computed from equilibrium properties alone. In its simplest form, it requires only a static susceptibility and an equilibrium variance of a system observable. We characterize this bound from weak to strong coupling in exactly solvable fermionic models, in the spin-boson model, and in a spin coupled to a two-dimensional Heisenberg antiferromagnet. These models show that strong coupling can lift the Planckian constraint when the MFG state retains little information about the system Hamiltonian, while preserving it when that information is carried by system observables with substantial equilibrium fluctuations at frequencies below $k_B T/\hbar$. The bound is complementary to open-system speed limits, since it constrains the acquisition of information rather than the preparation of the target, and can remain informative at strong coupling even when the latter become trivial.
summary:
1. 针对强耦合开放系统的热化是否受普朗克时间约束，作者要求同一机制热化一族邻近哈密顿量，并由平均力吉布斯态的可区分性推导时间下界。

title: Native higher-order optimization with entropy quantum computing
abstract: Higher-order interactions are common in applied optimization: parity checks, radar-code sidelobes, portfolio skewness and kurtosis, and marketing-channel synergies all yield cubic or quartic objectives. Quantum annealers and most Ising machines accept only quadratic objectives, and gate-based quantum processors build every higher-order term from two-qubit gates. Entropy quantum computing, realized in the hybrid photonic-electronic Dirac-3S system, accepts polynomials of degree up to five with all-to-all coupling over binary, integer or simplex-constrained continuous variables. No user-supplied quadratization or circuit compilation is needed. We formulate four industrial use cases as six cubic and quartic instances, run them on Dirac-3S with 30 samples each, and score every sample against a certified optimum or a classical best-known value. We also estimate their cost on quantum annealers, superconducting grids and trapped-ion registers under standard mappings. For the two densest instances, a portfolio with about 80,000 terms and a budget allocation with 360,000 terms, the quadratized problems need embeddings far beyond current annealers, over $10^5$ physical qubits for the portfolio alone, and one phase-separation layer costs over $10^6$ two-qubit gates before optimization. Dirac-3S ran all six natively and returned feasible, distinct solutions. All samples of the binary instances are single-flip local minima. The best portfolio sample lies within 0.32% of the best-known value and the best budget sample 15% above it, but no sample reached its reference. Classical solvers reach the references within minutes at these sizes, and random starts followed by a local polish reach comparable or better values, so the advantage established here is one of expressibility and mapping cost, not of solution quality. Whether it extends to time to solution at larger sizes remains open.
summary:
1. 作者在光电测量反馈平台Dirac-3S上原生运行六个三、四次优化实例，覆盖二元、整数和单纯形连续变量，每例采样30次并独立对照经典参考值。

title: Quantum dynamics of a charged particle on rotating curved surfaces and space curves in electromagnetic fields
abstract: We develop a gauge-consistent framework for a charged particle confined to a rotating curved manifold in an electromagnetic field, starting from the covariant Klein--Gordon equation. The non-relativistic reduction casts the rotational effects as effective gauge potentials while preserving the $U(1)$ symmetry, so that rotation and the external field enter alike, the geometry entering separately as the da Costa potential. The obstruction to dimensional reduction is gauge--geometry entanglement: transverse magnetic fields on a two-dimensional (2D) surface and structural torsion on a one-dimensional (1D) curve couple the tangential dynamics to the transverse degrees of freedom. We remove this entanglement by three mechanisms---a generalized transverse Poincaré gauge, the rotation-minimizing Bishop frame, and the parity of the transverse ground state, the last of which annihilates the residual first-order magnetic coupling for a single inversion-symmetric well. On a torus, an axial field generates a joint Sagnac--Aharonov--Bohm residual of tunable sign without spoiling the poloidal--azimuthal separability, whereas an in-plane field couples only through the out-of-plane extent of the structure: it breaks the axial symmetry there but leaves a planar curve unaffected to first order. The same torus shows the axial field tuning the curvature-induced localization, and a corrugated quantum ring converts periodic geometric and flux modulations into an artificial superlattice whose in-plane-field immunity follows from planarity and parity, not from the smallness of the field. Non-inertial quantum dynamics on surfaces and curves of arbitrary shape is thus reduced, within the thin-layer regime, to two ingredients: an effective gauge potential and a geometric potential.
summary:
1. 作者结合协变克莱因—戈登方程与薄层量子化，建立旋转曲面及空间曲线上无自旋带电粒子的规范协变低维动力学。
2. 在横向能隙占优的反演对称单阱中，横向规范、Bishop标架与基态宇称实现降维解耦，严格消除一阶横向磁耦合，使动力学由有效规范势及独立几何势描述。

title: Exponential Analysis for Trace-Distance Errors in Quantum Information Theory
abstract: We study the trace-distance error in classical-quantum soft covering, privacy amplification against quantum side information, convex splitting, and decoupling by a Haar-random unitary followed by partial trace. In the independent and identically distributed setting, we determine exact reliability functions and strong converse exponents for soft covering with independent codewords, uniform convex splitting, and Haar partial-trace decoupling. For privacy amplification, we determine the exact reliability function for independent random binning and the exact strong converse exponent for every two-universal hash ensemble. The reliability and strong converse formulas involve sandwiched and Petz-Rényi information, respectively. The proofs connect trace-distance errors to quantum hypothesis testing, using Rosenthal inequalities for sums of random matrices in the reliability analysis and conditional second-moment bounds for the strong converses.
summary:

2. 误差趋零与趋一的精确指数分别由夹心与Petz–Rényi信息给出，其中隐私放大的前者针对独立随机分箱，后者适用于任意二通用哈希族。
3. 强二通用哈希的显式实例表明，相同成对输出统计可对应不同可靠性指数，揭示隐私放大误差衰减对哈希系综涨落结构的依赖。

title: Resource theory of pi-ordered imaginarity and its resource quantifiers
abstract: Conventional resource theory of quantum imaginarity takes real density matrices as free states without ordering constraints on their diagonal populations. Motivated by the role of population ordering in the incoherent ergotropy of quantum batteries and the recently proposed framework of $\pi$-ordered coherence, we develop the resource theory of $\pi$-ordered imaginarity. In this refined framework, free states are required to be real in the reference basis and to obey a prescribed permutation order $\pi$ for their diagonal populations. This theory thereby identifies two independent quantum resources: complex phases and population misordering, where the latter is inaccessible within the standard imaginarity resource theory. We characterize the structure of free states using majorization and the Schur-Horn theorem, define admissible $\pi$-ordered real operations, and examine their intersection with $\pi$-ordered incoherent operations. We further construct resource quantifiers for the $\pi$-ordered imaginarity based on relative entropy, fidelity and robustness, and derive inequalities relating the robustness of $\pi$-ordered imaginarity and that of $\pi$-ordered coherence. The present framework generalizes the standard resource theory of imaginarity to incorporate population ordering and is naturally suited for thermodynamic settings such as quantum batteries.
summary:

2. 作者构造相对熵、保真度和鲁棒性度量，导出量子比特相对熵度量的闭式表达及鲁棒性的半正定规划，并证明其与π序相干性鲁棒性的界限关系。
3. 该框架识别了实态中由布居失序产生的非零资源，为研究量子电池中布居排序与功提取的联系提供定量工具。

title: Dynamics of a Charged Particle on a Conformal Helicoidal Surface
abstract: We study the classical and quantum motion of a charged particle on a conformal helicoidal surface embedded in four-dimensional Euclidean space. A uniform ambient magnetic field pulls back to a nonuniform surface field. The cyclic longitudinal coordinate permits an exact transverse reduction. The ordinary helicoid in the same axial field shares the effective potential and the turning points, while the conformal metric increases the physical period at matched energy and longitudinal momentum. We classify the single- and double-well regimes and obtain the exact transverse periods in the two double-well sectors. The periods diverge logarithmically at the separatrix, with twice the leading coefficient above the barrier as below it. The zero-field limit allows transverse escape, and the weak-twist limit is locally free but nonuniform across the surface. Intrinsic quantization gives an exact weighted transverse eigenvalue problem. Fixed-momentum eigenvalues test the harmonic approximation in a central well and resolve the tunneling splittings in a double well.

title: Slow mixing of Gibbs sampling for the quantum Curie-Weiss model
abstract: Hamiltonian evolution can spread local operators across a dense quantum magnet. We show that this global support does not remove the bottleneck to thermalization in the quantum Curie-Weiss model: at fixed low temperature and weak transverse field, the Chen-Kastoryano-Gilyen Gibbs sampler [arXiv: 2311.09207 ] has an exponentially large mixing-time lower bound. A dynamical quantum bottleneck theory that generalizes the classical notion of conductance has been proposed alongside existing frameworks that rely on spatial locality. We also give a complementary interpretation of slow mixing using an effective Fokker-Planck equation.

title: Unitary Synthesis with a Unary Tracker
abstract: This manuscript studies general unitary synthesis using unary-encoded ancillary register. Our first construction focuses on the $T$-cost of unitary synthesis. We maintain a unary register that coherently tracks the computational-basis label of the data. This allows Boolean lookups to use only CNOTs and shares the precision-dependent synthesis cost across the branches of each cosine-sine decomposition (CSD) factor. For a classically specified $n$-qubit unitary with $K$ mixing branches in its CSD, we obtain $T$-count $O(K+NL)$ using $N+O(L)$ clean ancillas, where $N=2^n$ and $L=n+\log(1/\epsilon)$. We also give a related construction that directly applies the unitary onto a unary register to implement disjoint branches in parallel. Combining this with the quantum Shannon decomposition gives space-depth volume $O(N^2)$ using arbitrary single-qubit gates and CNOTs, which matches the asymptotically optimal bound.

2. 借助理想相位梯度催化态，误差ε的Clifford+T合成需O(K+NL)个T门和N+O(L)个洁净辅助位，其中N=2^n、L=n+log(1/ε)，K为给定分解的混合分支数。
